Physical Description: Fenn is a short foxlike humanoid with wild hair and a ceramic white mask that covers her face.  She wears simple clothing, and has emerald green eyes that can sometimes be seen behind her mask
Quirks:
**Outcast Fairy**
Speak to Beasts, Elementals, Plants
Learn 1 spell (Drain Spirit)
Do rituals
Use rituals to transport creatures into/out of faerie realm
Weakness: When Fenn loses their mask, they have to obey all commands they're given by the first person who's eyes they look into.  This effect is broken if she wears her mask again.
Story Summary:
-Kicked out of Fairy Realm
-Kidnapped by a noble to Lastport
-Escaped and left him for dead
-Lived in Gwaed Forest
-Stole to survive

Physical Description: Fox stands roughly around 5'10 (177cm). He has vibrant blue hair thats been dyed from its normal colors. A pair of glasses rest neatly against his nose and a same color of blue fills his irises. Usually dressed in warmer clothing with a scarf around his neck. His jacket having the E.T.A  logo along the arm and back. On his back is a long bag with a zipper along the top of it. Usually he has a small wristpad that assists him with Soulrunning or technology usage in general.
Story Summary:
- Was raised in a 'paycheck to paycheck' kind of family. Eventually wanted to make something of his life and started learning anything and everything he could.
- Eventually became a rising star in the area of Soulrunning. SWORD took notice of his work and hired him to lead a small team of Temps.
- Worked as a Temp for a few years till a new hire was assigned to his team by the name of Yuna. Soon after that the team was killed in an ambush besides for Yuna and Gabriel.
- ETA took notice of the failed job and forced them both into a debt that they needed to worked under ETA to pay off.
- Was assigned the Callsign "Fox" and Gabriel Astrea was pronounced KIA on the mission they failed.

Character Sheet Link:
[Silent shadow glides,
Soft whispers through moonlit trees,
Calm in night's embrace.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1DufpwzVEk9ytDnAG-xDGUtZUKD1B1i7frVJKckDY_5U/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description:
After a ritual that pushed her to her limits, Kage now resembles more of a person and less of a walking nightmare. Standing at roughly five feet four, the young Half-Kitsune seems far healthier than when she first appeared on the Worldhelm. She now possesses an athletic physique befitting her station, no longer marred by the side-effects of her training. While her almost glowing cyan eyes remain alongside the foxfire burning within her body, her expressions are no longer muted, wearing her emotions far more freely.

Her wardrobe consists of her old bodysuit, now far more distinguishable from her pitch black skin, however she no longer hides herself behind an oversized poncho, opting instead to wear a sleeveless open vest. Her attire is dotted with white and grey geometrical shapes and symbols, in the past she marked herself as such as to not truly disappear in pitch black darkness, nowadays however it’s simply to remember the past.
Quirks:
Qi Specialist : Void

Change damage to Air | Resistant to Air | Weak to Light | Able to preform Void domain arcanism rituals
Story Summary:
- Born in the forests surrounding Sakai, after a failed Kitsune expedition from the south.
- Her parent, instead of leaving her to the elements choose to excommunicate themselves from Sakai
- Years later the child would return to Sakai, now changed and alone
- Taking up the name "Kage", she'd become a Disciple under the leader of Sakai, seeking to learn balance and perhaps one day reverse whatever have caused their body to change
- Despite never fully fitting in, she'd find companionship with several new pupils who see her for the warrior she is, and not the monster that others see
- Having reached a plateau in her cultivation, her master suggested her to leave for the deserts. To either overcome her trials, or to do what many before her has and slaughter Yokai.
- Seeking a better alternative for the people of Sakai, she'd try and overcome her trials, only to be left in a pool of her own blood. Not long after she was caught in an all too familiar storm, lifting her to the worldhelm.

Physical Description: Yuna is a average 5'5 woman with white hair. Her piercing red eyes are analytical and fierce. Hiding most of her feelings behind a stoic visage. Though this is not to say she is afraid of voicing them to most people. Yuna regularly wears robes passed down from her family, she rarely speaks about the significance of them as she has yet to speak to them since her incident. They are painted over in black ink and dotted in minor tears.
Story Summary:
||Yuna Manami was a starry eyed girl from South Rock when she first began her foraying into working as a temp. Born into a family of competent swordsmen, Yuna was directed onto the the temp worker path from a young age.

During her time she met a man named Gabriel, who served as a specialist and handler for a ragtag group of temp workers.

It wasn't long until Gabriel and her grew close. And she made fast friends with the other members of their group. Her future was looking bright, until a operation gone wrong took the lives of three of their group.

Pushed into a corner and desperate, her sword skills were not enough to save her friends. Despite the clear directions to not open the prototype box they had been tasked with collecting. Yuna did so, in the hopes that maybe whatever was in it would save her and allow her to avenge her fallen comrades.

Before she knew it, she had bound herself to the experimental weapon. Shackling her and the surviving members with debt to ETA.|| <- Gms :3

Character Sheet Link: [*"Any powerful demon's best kept secret is their true name." - "Trillion"*](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cscZWGXFaK-OtjjxxgLYjW-U8lW7lm0-lZ6JMSQPDiY/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
Physical Description: "Trillion" stands at a modest height of 5'9", with a slim, athletic frame akin to that of a young adult. His youthful appearance is marked by his vibrant blue hair and glowing golden eyes; however, he is also easily distinguished by his demonic features that have manifested with his time as a revered Witch of Aaruna. Equally vibrant blue scales fleck across his face, neck, and limbs; and his slender fingers are complemented by long and sharp, black nails. Despite this, there is an overall welcoming warmth to his composure.
Story Summary:
- Once the leader of a great Circle in Idyll's Third Layer.
- No longer a Witch of the Circles, he now seeks to find a new way of surviving.
- Wishes to spread his pacifistic ideals in order to hopefully bring peace to Kuzunoha of Idyll.

Physical Description:
A long green snake.....That is sadly is Asva who still holds glimmer of human sadness in his eyes. 
Now with his human voice stolen he fully fits the part of a snake.......he also got bigger.

A man standing at about 5'11, medium length dark brown hair and a darker olive skin tone with hazel hued eyes, they have an odd faint glow about them in both eyes and body. Holding a genuinely young and kind expression that easily shifts to earnest one in times of hardship and danger. Their hands are somewhat bruised and rough from work and battle. They are very well acquainted to physical labor of many kinds for long hours just to get by during travels and it shows.
Story Summary:
- Adelphel was initially a formless spirits that simply existed in nature until captured by a Necromancer to be used in a magical experiment for a subservient creation in the wake of recent disasters. They were augmented, altered and bound into a humanoid body, however all the changes caused instability in the magic and retained free will to act independently. Deemed a failure as a result.
- They have traveled throughout Kor'Tarion helping those they come across of all kinds when able without discrimination.
- They offer aid for many issues, from things like helping with a farm or defending people from life or death situations, doing so without want of reward in return.
- They appears to be a knight of some kind in attire but holds no real symbol nor claims any titles.
- They don't appear to have memories of their past, in a sense of they remember having parents and living in a nice village but nothing solid. The lack of past and memories causes them to cherish new meetings.

Physical Description:
A purple haired woman wearing a prom and proper uniform of the Gnosis Academy, Aelina has fair skin and bright violet eyes. Two black horns poke out of the top of her head and her hands are adorned with 9 metal rings of various colors. 

Her sword form is a large curved blade with holes in the back with loose rings hanging from each one but the first.
Story Summary: A student of the Gnosis Academy House of Treasures, Aelina has become a regalia of Kaiway. At home in Ripplith she is from a former noble house of storm sorcerers that is under the Mermaid Queen.

Physical Description: Aer stands tall at 6'0", her posture ever straight, radiating poise and grace. Her long, curly brown hair cascades down past her waist, framing her commanding presence. She dons armor adorned in rich tones of brown, brass, and deep blue, exuding both strength and elegance. Black feathers accentuate her ensemble, lending her an air of formidable beauty and otherworldly might.
Quirks:
You have spent a long, long time here in Idyll. Maybe a year, maybe a hundred. It's hard to tell. But you feel different now - more natural to the realm that has become your home. You've changed, hopefully for the better. Angel of Nimue

You may verbally communicate with any creature belonging to the demon, elemental, and undead Species.  

You learn one spell of your choice among those in the lists for the Elemental, Entro and Spirit Classes in the Core Rulebook: [Heal]

Weakness: Valkyrie's Mercy
Aer feels an unshakable compulsion to offer solace to the spirits of the dead or dying, unable to ignore their suffering or pass them by without a gesture of comfort
Story Summary:
Aer Drasil was a fearless huntress and protector, renowned for her skill with a spear and unwavering resolve. After falling heroically in battle, she awakened in Asga, a warrior’s paradise in the afterlife, where honor and strength were celebrated. However, this realm soon fell into madness, its duels turning into an endless cycle of carnage and death. Refusing to succumb, Aer became a Valkyrie, finding refuge in Salmon’s Reach and dedicating herself to shielding lost souls from the corruption that tainted her once-ideal afterlife. 

Yet now, with the chaos subsiding and her quarry defeated, she faces a new challenge. Discovering who she is beyond the battlefield and what her future may hold.

Physical Description: Aerah is a 19 year old girl who is 5' 7". She has long black hair with a bit of green tones in it. She is typically walking around in a body suit and fancy skates to allow her quicker movement.
Quirks:
Heirloom - Vocal Stabilizer
Flaw - When using a magichant GM can declare this item fails to work and Aerah begings breaking down into a coughing fit. The magichant isn't used but the MP and action are lost.
Rare Equipment: Vocal Stabilizer - [WLP + WLP]+1 [HR+4] Energy Vampire
Story Summary:
- Was born with a magical mutation that causes her voice to be volatile if uncontrolled, as such she was told not to speak.
- Due to an outburst she ended up accidently killing one of her bullies as a child and harming other.
- This lead to law suits putting her family into debt, which her mother tried to gamble to get out of.
- 777LC saw potential with Aerah's talents and offered her a job to help pay off her family's debt.
- This lead to her joining their Roller Derby circuit that people bet on.

Physical Description: Agata is a young woman standing at about 5'10 in height. She has long blonde hair tied back in a pony tail most times. Her clothes usually are stained with oil and grease as the scent of machinery follows her around.

Akahime, the Winter Serpent, is an ethereal being with a long, serpentine lower body that is is cloaked in obsidian-black scales, coiling with silent grace across the frozen wastes she calls home. Towering and poised, her upper half bears the countenance of a pale, silver-haired Ald—yet her piercing gaze and the faint, otherworldly glow in her pale eyes betray something far older and deeper.

She dons ornate, silver-on-black armor. Flowing silks trail from beneath the plate, catching ghostlight as she moves. In her hands, she wields the Night Lantern, a staff bound with chains and a crimson lantern that bleeds spectral mist. Its flickering light draws spirits near, some seeking peace—others, prey.
Quirks:
Heirloom: The Night Lantern

The Night Lantern guides the lost—those whose spirits wander through the bleak blizzards where even Akahime's sirenic voice cannot reach. Yet, the lantern’s light pierces through. Suspended from its chain at the end of her staff, it offers a sense of control, comfort, and quiet confidence to those nearby. In her hands, it becomes more than a beacon—it is a weapon, radiant and resolute, used to banish darkness in all its forms. Unfortunately, not everything the lantern attracts is friendly...
Rare Equipment:
The Night Lantern

Custom Item: 
Base Form: Arcane, melee, [HR+7], [WIL + WIL], Transforming, Magic Defense Boost, Defense Boost, Damage type: Light
Transformation: Flail, melee, [HR+12], [DEX + WIL], Transforming, Accurate, Powerful, Damage type: Light
Rare Item Quality: Harmonious, Damage Change - Light"
Story Summary:
- Serpentine yokai who guides lost souls through frozen Aldistir.

- Found the glowing Night Lantern at the Grasping Tree.

- Became a beacon for the lost- and threats.

- Trained to protect the souls she ferries.

- Hunts godblood corrupted beings to free them from torment.

- Thanks to the Worldhelm, she now travels between realms, continuing her sacred task.

Physical Description:
Akar wears a comfortable, white robe and a heavy, black robe over his left shoulder. The seams of both his tunic and his robe are adorned with soft sheep wool. Both his lower arms and ankles are covered in red threads. Akar wears many decorative charms and colourful decorations, including earrings and a talisman in the shape of a bell, which is tied to his collar. He almost never seen without his shepherd crook, which is also adorned with the same charms and bells he wears on his body.

His long, red hair is tied into a casual braid. The young shepherd has small goat horns, growing from just above his ears. Usually his face has a soft expression with a bright smile on his lips and shining, green eyes.
Story Summary:
- Born and raised to a small family in the peaceful mountain ranges of Paradise on Idyll
- Shepherd of a small flock of sheep. He spent his time protecting and caring for them and his friends and family, with little of nothing to worry about.
- One day, one of his sheep, Nyima, gets lost in a Realm Storm and he goes off in search of her
- Now lost and confused in a world filled with strife and chaos, he tries to get back to his flock, but also take care of anyone he might meet along the way.

Physical Description: Akiko is a muscular young woman standing at 5'8" with long black hair and pale skin. Her eyes are a dull amber color, but a spark of light gleams within when she wields her black and gold shields that seem like two broken halves of one sun. Though once tense and rigid, she now smiles readily, her hope for the new dawn all but radiating from her demeanor.
Quirks:
Heirloom | Amaterasu's Relic Shield Halves
Susanoo's anger towards those who would wield his ashamed sister's relics chases them even across realms. Wherever these shield halves are, storms pursue. Upon Tian Yin, Susanoo's followers seek out this broken relic, and the pieces are a beacon to hungering Yokai.
Rare Equipment:
Radiant Runic Half (Runic Shield- Memorize [Flare])
Sanctuary Runic Half (Runic Shield- Antistatus [Poisoned])
Story Summary:
Akiko was born in the village of Ishiyama. The same as every other human, she fell under the thumb of the Oni; though, with natural fire Qi affinity revealed, she was claimed by a powerful red Oni. They took her to the Temple of the Rising Sun as a living forge to make a powerful arsenal. 

This was where she found her shields, hidden beneath the rubble in a relic room long forgotten. Taking them in either hand cast upon her soul a heavenly fire, at long last ridding her of the hopeless fog that left her willfully chained under the Yokai. She fled, falling into a realmstorm and finding a new home in the Worldhelm. She has spent much of her time in isolation to cultivate her connection to Amaterasu, but only the desperate fight against Loftur has finally awakened a deeper understanding of her Dao: the Sunless Dawn.

Physical Description: Wrapped beneath a worn cloak, Aly occupies what was, at one point, clearly a streamlined, and admittedly compact, modern LUA chassis. She sports a concerning amount of wear and tear, along with mismatched and unlicensed replacement parts. From behind a cracked screen, she looks back at the world with eyes that manage to appear tired, despite their lack of detail.
Story Summary:
- Experimental digital backup of a Lorel.AI software engineer.
- Awoken under concerning circumstances with corrupted memories and a bounty on her head.
- Spent months evading Terra's authorities and doing soul net work for less than reputable benefactors to pay for repairs and upkeep.
- Became embroiled in the affairs of a group of Goldhearted, and took her chance to get aboard the Worldhelm to get out of dodge.
- Hoping to eventually figure out what she was doing before her memories were corrupted (and also who she even really is).
- Recently recovered data from a corrupted memory of her shooting someone.

Physical Description:
Albreich stands at about 6'2", 

Though he trains his body regularly he only does as much as he needs to wield his weapon comfortably, preferring to forgo the bulging muscles for a body that allows more dexterous movements.

He carries himself with the confidence and poise of a man with twice his experience, after all the best way to win a fight is to stop it from happening in the first place. 
(Will add more later, this is the thing I suck at most)
Story Summary:
A would be knight that ran away to become a mercenary after growing disillusioned by the crown's inability to take action. Deciding to serve his own interests rather than paying lip service to grandiose ideals like chivalry and knighthood.

After a couple winters working as a freelance mercenary he joined the Golden Claw Mercenaries, much to his surprise he was chosen as a Goldhearted a year after he'd joined the company.

Physical Description: Straight, tall, and lithe, covered in silver and white dappled fur, he stands at 5'11'' (not including the antlers) on deer-like hooves, peering at you with what look like distant reflections of stars in his blue(?) eyes. He usually wears a combination of shirts under knit sweaters, and maybe a night blue coat lined with white fur. He adorns himself with a pair of simple, hand-made necklaces, and a single earring on his left ear.
Quirks:
Outcast Fairy
Drawback: Is compelled to heal nature that is hurting.
Rare Equipment:
- Fey's Light (Main hand.) (One-handed Staff. HR+3 Light.) (Blessed Bonds quality.)
- Tomagotchy Cell Phone (Accessory.) (Spell Splash quality)
Story Summary:
- Lived with his nomadic people and family, the Deerfolk, following the guidance of the elementals via a Hearer, nurturing life along the way. 
- Before becoming Goldhearted, he was suddenly, mysteriously, shunted out from his mother's domain, and hasn't been able to get back in or find his family. 
- He has recently found his mother, Willow, learning that the Wyld Hunt has been responsible for hunting and tearing Fey, particularly those of the Spring Court, from their domains. He has also learned that his mother has had dealings with the Spring Court as well, but doesn't quite know how deep it runs.
- He still doesn't know that his mother managed to get Caladrius' favor to bestow upon Alder some of his power to protect him.
- Has yet to become fully aware of his aptitude as a Hearer for his people
- Yuzuru Eiji of Terra is his boyfriend. c:

Physical Description: Slender and fragile-looking, but with a confident aura of power. Always carries his Tome, which doubles as his Journal, where he records his findings and experiment results.
Rare Equipment: Personal Tome (Tome + Spell Vamp)

Physical Description: Alec is a tall, athletic man who stands at 5'11" (180cm). Usually wears a smile on his face when interacting with most people. Typically wears a set of battle armor when he's on the job, but otherwise the casual jacket and pants when not on the job. His grayish-white hair done in a stylish mess, with gentle amber eyes.
Story Summary:
- Born to a working class family in Babyl City, Dawnstar Valley.
- Has a natural gift of controlling light and spiritual magic.
- Attended school normally, where he met and befriended Mae Lavery who was a grade year above him.
- Majoring in magic, he eventually graduated and took a position in working for a subsidiary of NTTech that enforces the regulations on magic. Training in both body and magic, putting his skills to use.
- Due to budget reasons, ended up moving into an apartment with Mae about 3 years prior. Then eventually formed a romantic relationship with her.
- 1 year prior to today, Mae Lavery suffered a tragic accident and died. Then she became an Insolvent with a debt over her head. Doing their best to live with the circumstances.
- Thanks to the use of his own spiritual magic and martial training, he was able to successfully mitigate casualties during the events of the Skyfall. Soon leading him to arrive on the Worldhelm, becoming a Goldhearted.

Character Sheet Link: [This body we inhabit, the life we have assumed. Just who are we?](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xyGnsU-fai-OBW0JofqC_a7REKDjOt4IVDF_w8FJSWU/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: A suit of armor that moves with an unnaturalness. Almost as if mimicking the people around them.
Story Summary:
* A plant native to Barza that awakened in the wake of being discarded by Tubulcain as unneeded in their grand design. 
* Seeking answers to their own existence, and the existence they seemed to have inherited by using the suit as their body.

Physical Description: Light grey almost white hair, constant stern look on his face with piercing red eyes. Wears a formal but out of fashion suit with a red tie.
Story Summary:
- Born and Raised in Mount Providence having a passion for classical songs by hearing it from a radio

- Passed away due to illness before he could get a proper start in the singing industry and became an insolvent due loans from education as well as equipment

- After almost a decade of trying to pay the debt off working entry level jobs in Central, Alexander moved back to Mount Providence almost ready to give up and become a ghoul.

- Instead his passion for the classical music reignites as he a found a old oprea piece and sang his heart out.

- With a new sense of duty he goes out to abandon buildings and churches to find more pieces like the one he found that day to preserve them so that others can still listen

- Currently works at a SWORD affiliated branch at the Fortune Valley Casino where he entertains guests with songs and help remix classic sheet music for SWORD to reuse in their products.

- Got picked up by the realmstorm when scavenging for more antiques

Physical Description: Alexei is of average to thin stature and around 5'7'' tall. He's pale, his eyes eerily empty of any colour besides white and grey, and his black hair mirrors this scheme with long streaks of white already showing on the otherwise seemingly young man's black hair. Most notably, Alexei has a large scar that runs down his left cheek, neck and further down. Its not certain how large the scar is, as it eventually disappears under his Gnosis Academy uniform.
Story Summary:
- Alexei attends Gnosis Academy and is on the Worldhelm as part of the school's new 'Exchange' program
- He has enjoyed a rather privileged life under his parents, who are both rather powerful spellcasters based out of Dreadlan
- Past encounters with members of Ursakk's Hoard have made him particularly opposed to the organization, though since entering the academy, he hasn't really had a chance to enact his negative feelings toward them

Physical Description: A relatively tall, well kept man with black hair wearing loose but well fitting clothes.
Quirks:
Old Transport (Skyship)
You own an old vehicle that you love dearly. Unfortunately, the cursed thing barely
holds together and won’t stop causing you trouble. Did you build this vehicle yourself,
or did you receive it from someone? What very specific flaw or quirk makes it unique?
What makes it extremely recognizable?


- Can have technical issues due to Alwyn's lack of technical know how. Can be minor as screens not turning on or as major as key components shutting off.
- Easily Recognizable to those who have knowledge on the Red Roses.
Story Summary: A wanted Sky Pirate whom currently flies alone. Though he is wanted for Theft and Assault, there is no evidence that he has done so to any non-noble/rich people/group.

Physical Description: Amber is a middle aged Felkin with thick black hair.  Her eyes shift between green and yellow depending on the light.  She wears round glasses, and a doctor's coat over basic clothes.  She's usually frowning and/or smoking.
Story Summary: A divorced single mom, her daughter ran away and she's trying to find her

Physical Description:
Ambrose is a small person at only 4'5", whose lithe body is hidden underneath a couple layers of baggy mage clothing and alchemist tools laid atop them. He carries a large backpack covered in meticulously maintained labels. Any educated person in Kor'Tarion would quickly realize that this guy's inventory is stocked with magical payload that could easily raze a small town, if not most of a large city.

Dangling from a short rope attached to the wrist is a charred wand, with its core compartment and focus crystal empty, and waiting for its next configuration.
Amelia is a woman of average 5'4 stature with short pale yellow hair and bright red eyes. She often is dressed somewhat professionally and in light colors.
Story Summary:
- Was born in North Rock and had an uneventful life, coming from two hardworking, low-income parents.
- Taking a leap as a young adult, she took out some loans to begin her college education, reasoning that she could surely pay it off once she found a proper career after graduation.
- After graduating, her friends treated her out to celebrate. Being as ecstatic as she was, she overindulged and died that night due to alcohol poisoning. This also soured many of her friendships once she returned as an Insolvent.
- She spent the last 5 years trying to live a normal life, having found an entry-level journalist position for one of Galeforce's smaller newspaper subsidiaries and struggling to move up in the company.

Physical Description: Amina is a tall woman, with her most striking features being her pallid skin and her dull red eyes. She's garbed in an eccentric outfit, blending together old styles with modern utilities that end in her appearing like some sort of cosplayer, rather than an adventurer.
Story Summary:
- In ancient Terra, a family of diviners made a deal with a dark group in the future, offering up one of their descendants as payment

- In the modern day, Amina, the last known descendant of that family and practitioner of their techniques, was wrapped up in a plot by ET Aquisitions, making her into an Insolvent 

- While using her predictive powers in service of ETA, she tried her best to help the people of Terra with her magic, efforts that eventually got her recognized by the Worldhelm

Physical Description: Anahi is a muscular, 5'11 human woman with ragged traveler's clothes. Her armor is made entirely of fibers and cloth with a strong floral scent.

Anderth is a buff, stocky man who stands at 6'3". He wears a thin, patchwork shirt and a durable pair of trousers. His boots are so dirty it's hard to tell where they end and where his legs begin. He carries a beat-up pickaxe with a bunch of counting marks on it. He also wears a utility belt that has all the essentials for a miner. A lantern, oil, rope, a hunting knife, several maps, and various satchels and pockets. Anderth is usually wearing a scowl.

Anise is a tall and imposing woman, standing at around 6'0" and wielding a large but otherwise ordinary greatsword. Her hair is light brown and often kept in the style of a chignon, pinned in place by the binyeo she wears. Up-close, scale-shaped brands can be seen going up her neck and parts of her face, though they are mostly hidden by her shawl and hair. Anise dresses in loose-fitting garb, accustomed to the heat of Nezmira. Other identifying features include her golden-yellow eyes, and small pieces of debris float around her at times, as if Anise had her own small gravitational field.

Standing at 5'7" and carrying himself with dignity. Apollo is a Yellow-olive scale colored Nezzim with a dainty form. He sports two sets of horns, green eyes, and a pair of glasses, likely to help with reading all the books he tends to carry around. He can typically be seen wearing his Kaiway uniform. A fuschia-colored top with baggy upper-arm sleeves, a crimson scarf, and a pauldron, along with a courier bag containing all of his necessities. He moves with grace and fluidity, often carrying a smug expression on their face.
Story Summary:
- Comes from a very toxic family of a distancing father and Egocentric mother
- Father is a well established and proficient paladin, Mother is a bureaucrat and spokeperson/negotiator for one of Heartdoms larger regions.
- At home was constantly abused for his lack of strength and capability. Mother only expects excellence to make herself look good, and her behaviour caused his golden child of a brother to do the same.
- Ran away from home to enroll into Gnosis Academy against his family's wishes, initially enrolled as a Paladin to get back at them by trying to be better than his brother.
- After his first year at the academy, seeing his overall results were not up to par, he changed to the House of Treasures to become a Regalia. Succeeding in the necessary measures to achieve that, Apollo now having become the Overture, he chose Perseus to become his Regent.

Physical Description: Saki is a medium height at 4'11 very thin girl with long white hair. It often sticks up at odd angles either due to lack of care or to differentiate herself from her twin sister. Her normally blank expression hides eyes that seem to always be watching for trouble. She tends to wear heavier jackets that almost look too big for her and combat boots.
Story Summary: A twin born in Haven to an affluent mother, she abandoned that life to work as a temp to support her sister.

Physical Description: Small Kitsune Ninja with silver hair and fur. Carries large Three Bladed Shuuriken and a goofy grin.  (WIP)
Story Summary:
* Was born during a Thunderstorm
* Became an Orphan
* Lives because others cannot
* Enjoys exploring

Origin: Kor'Tarion: The White Feather House of Youth
Physical Description: Argad is a tall person with a bulky muscular body. His hair, almost as black as obsidian, a meticulously groomed beard, and intense black eyes give him an even more intimidating appearance. If it weren't for the almost constant smile on his face, no one would approach him.

Aria is a 5'4ft lady, with vibrant short red hair. She seems small at a distance but up close it easy to see she is containing muscles that have been honed for decades that allow her to back up the things she says.
Rare Equipment:
A Conflux of Rivers (World Saver)
[DEX + MIG] + 5 [HR + 15] Bolt
Elemental: Bolt | Defensive | Powerful
Story Summary:
-Born to one of the Matriarchs of Tangbawan.
-Was taught cultivation from Kabiya and traveled with them from a very young age
-Powerful Yokai assaulted a group she and Kabiya was apart of. Kabiya passed but Aria found a new mentor among the group.
-Soon after fell into a realmstorm and brought to the Worldhelm

Physical Description: Standing at 5'8", Arija has an athletic build. She wears battle attire designed for agility on the battlefield. Her skin is fair, her eyes a striking sapphire blue, and her long brown hair is pulled into a wispy ponytail.
Rare Equipment: War King's Wrath

Physical Description: A fair skinned male standing tall at 6'2'' with cyan hair. Decorated in earthern green heavy armor a look of starwartness and alertness is present on his face. At his side is a large regal axe and a shield matching the armor. Despite the weight or burden of the gear, his gait does not show strain or heavy steps.

Physical Description: Though only 5'10'' in height, Brandr is a unit of a man sporting only pants as most shirts are impossible for him to wear. Having a broad, wide, and stocky build that stores within it a well of power from his large arms and heavyset build. It is a form that opts for strength and brawn, visible in even subtle movements as what could be mistaken for pudge holds muscles underneath. His fiery mane of hair flickers and moves like a living flame. As he himself loses energy, though it takes on a black charcoal look to it. His skin is a dark ashen coloration and resembles scales or cooled plates of magma. Cracks and lines along it run heat akin to lava running through veins. Sporting light tribal markings along with piercings, many can tell he hails from Aldistir as an Oni if they're familiar with that realm. Despite his fanged maw, horned helm, and burning ember like eyes, Brandr comes off as a gentle giant or someone constantly trying to be friendly when not in the throes of combat.
Story Summary:
- Was born an Ald within a warband known as Foxhunt, hunters of Yokai.
- After being separated during an attack, he was left to wander the Kald Forest alone.
- Starving, he found the body of a near dead Yokai and in desperation consumed it's body and killed it.
- Due to this act, Kuzunoha cursed/blessed him with a Yokai's body (elemental soul & Mutant)
- He tried to return home, was almost murdered by his own family until he fled.
- Living out in the woods as a "monster", he stumbled onto Olia as a child.
- Her genuine innocence and sweet nature moved his heart, and he decided to raise and protect her.

Story Summary:
- Brooks Howard was born into wealth in Vinyard but lost everything when his father’s financial crimes led to the family’s exile and disgrace.

- Drifting far from Vinyard, he was forced to survive in Liberty Desert, Brooks became a rogue and mercenary, using his charm and cunning to carve out a living.

- He reunited with a woman named Esmeralda, a brilliant engineer and former love, rekindling their bond before her jealous husband orchestrated her tragic death.

- Stricken with grief, Brooks became an Insolvent, cursed to immortality until his debts are paid, clinging to her memory as his reason to endure.

- Over 120 years later, all he has left of Esmeralda is his shotgun, named after her, a fading relic of a life and love long lost.

Carol is a relatively diminutive person, only standing to about 5'4" tall. This, combined with their cherubic, androgynous features gives them a very unthreatening appearance that makes it difficult for people to take them seriously. They are of fair skin tone, often somewhat flush. They have mid-length brown hair, impressing somewhere between tastefully curly and mildly unkempt. Their eyes are like plump cherries: red, wide, and bright. They wear practical adventuring gear, leather jackets, and are strapped with an array of gadgets. Their tools, trinkets, and otherwise useful items are kept in a large shoulder-strapped bag.
Story Summary:
Carol lived with their family, and many others in a frontier village at the very edge of the Marrane border. In semi-secret their family engaged in trade and barter with the travelers, settlers, and militia of Karlsgard. During this time Carol became a shrewd, and discerning businessman, but was later sent back to Korala to receive a proper education.

Carol received formal certification in R&D, and Engineering, as well as compelled military service training.

Upon returning home Carol discovered that their village, and others close to the border had been pillaged and bombarded in a push by revolutionaries to reclaim land. Despite only mild losses, the Marrane retaliation was massive, and deadly.

Carol was so distressed by the violence that they defected from Marrane, and assisted Karlsgard villagers in their efforts of recovery and defense. Despite their desperation Carols efforts were valiant, and in their darkest moment they were chosen to be Goldhearted.

- Caspian is the third generation of this family, with a very strict upbringing. However he is usually overlooked often in Ripplith society, and thus developed an inferiority complex to his peers.

- Became an Arcanist of Lilith for the rebellious act itself, seeing him as someone who shows promise.
- Caspian does suffer a very negative reputation in the Academy as a result. Becoming much more distant than initially, feeling a perpetual sense of guilt around Aelina.

Physical Description:
Ci-Ci is a bubbly 4'11 girl with a lean but powerful physique. Her skin is a pastel shade of pink and her eyes sparkling a curious ocean blue. Her hair is a similar color to her skin, with accents of red.  No one is exactly certain why her eyes became hearts after her ritual with the Seamother, but she sure thinks it's cute. Other notable features is the quite large tail which serves greatly in the ocean, but seems to only enhance the girl's clumsiness on land.

Other notable features is the large seashell shaped weapon that she carries either on her shoulder or on her back. As she walks, you can hear the light clanging sound of symbol-like metal inside the shell. It is an heirloom she wields proudly.

Seamother's Pendant (No HR loss on vibrato when targeting ally with chant)
Story Summary:
- Cecillia was born in Ripplith as a man, Her family carried a gift from the Ocean Singers, a magical weapon that resonates with songs of the ocean. She at first couldn't lift it.

- Even before her transition, she was talented in the roles of a woman, taking the skillset far easier than the ones given to her as a man, this helped her realize that she was more comfortable presenting as a girl. She sought out a Seamother.

- After going through the ritual, she found a weight lifted off of her and was able to carry her family heirloom. Her family sent her to Gnosis Academy.

- She is quite the character, and so regularly had friction with stricter teachers due to her bubbly and excitable personality.

- She didn't get into too much trouble thanks to good grades. But that all changed when she heard about remedial classes and the opportunity to go to new places.

- Despite the look on her academic record, she tanked her grades to get into the remedial course. She is hungry for adventure.

Physical Description: Circuit's frame is compact (5'8"), but bulky (223 lbs). Their attire for jobs (unless requested) is a tailored suit with the sleeves rolled up to keep the arms (and gauntlets) free. Gotta stay professional!
Story Summary:
- Commissioned at the [request of a LUA couple](<https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1170110466299809873/1291077076010668072>) in Silver Rock, Haven.
- Really enjoyed watching boxing and gladiator style matches, "growing up".
- Wanted to become a prize fighter, but they could not make the cut for a SWORD sponsorship.
- Eventually saved up for an ETA license and started doing Temp jobs to make ends meet. Has cultivated the suit and gauntlets image to make themselves seem more professional!

- They're still looking for that big break that will make them famous...and maybe this Worldhelm can help them in that regard!

- Grew up with a coven of Forest Witches hidden in the far northeastern region of the Gwaed Forest below the Star Peaks.
- Received tutelage of a talented witch in the coven named Althea Starbloom, who became her mentor-mother figure.
- When Althea was called to perform an odyssey across Kor’tarion, she passed down her verdant locket as a gesture of motherly love.
- Upon adulthood, Daisy finally left her coven to attempt the odyssey herself, in hopes of one day reuniting with Althea and solidify her own competency as a green witch.

Physical Description: A lavender swordswoman who leaves trails of vibrant peach blossoms in her path. Tall and slender woman with jet black hair tied in a high-top ponytail, eyes the color of violets, wears a slim battle tunic and pants, carries a Jian sword in the scabbard by hand. Height 5' 8".

Well-built man of average height; there’s an air of gravitas around him that always seems to match the current circumstance. Long brown hair and the clothing and armor befitting the dashing hero that he is.
Story Summary: A slightly washed up street performer in Brightshield, Dante has a heart of gold and a drive to be an actual hero. Hopefully he’ll get there soon.

Physical Description: Daphila stands at a staggering 3'2". She has long sparkling purple hair and is usually carrying around a pack full of trinkets twice her size. Making jingles, and rattles everywhere she goes.
Story Summary:
- Born in a small community of fae creatures who are adept at magic

- Never leanred how to wield magic, instead learns how to craft toys

- Gets inspired to leave her home when her toys bring joy to those around her. She leaves and starts a career as a traveling toymaker.

Physical Description: Dastan is a human, 5'11 ft tall with a well built body. He has tanned skin, shoulder length blue hair and golden eyes. Often wearing ornate clothing that as well as jewelry.
Quirks:
Heirloom:
Raging Sun

A large, blood-red gemstone set in brass. This cursed gem clouds minds with uncontrollable 
fury, driving nearby creatures into a frenzy of fight or flight. 
Forged from the crystallized blood of the Kiir, it irresistibly attracts them to its bearer.
Rare Equipment:
Raging Sun
Heirloom accessory with the goading quality

Flaw:
The Raging Sun attracts Kiir, it might also freak out other creatures triggering a fight or flight response.

Physical Description: Standing roughly at 5'8 (172 cm) she stands a few inches above average for her people. Before she was  malnourished and barely alive. Now, Dawn stands proudly for her people. Gifted with the power of Dusk and Dawn she glows faintly with an golden light. One of her eyes a crimson red and the other a pale turquoise. Proudly she shows off her draconic features, adorning her horns with jewelry to show devotion to the Dragonlord of Dawn.
Rare Equipment:
Ritual Dagger: Steady Bloodletting
Ritual Sealer: DMG change Light
Story Summary:
-An Ophidiya and descendant of the Dragonlord of Dusk Layl.
-Survived in the sand dunes and was hunted by the Nezzim.
-Picked up by Goldhearted after watching mom die from the Kiir.
-Survived the casting of the Song of Betrayal with the gift of Dawn from Dragonlord Atem.
-Has control over both the Dusk and Dawn with the power of an Arcanum from Atem.

Physical Description: Dirty blonde hair, skin white, and eyes green like emeralds. Deacon stands at a height 5'7ft, his physique skinny and average in almost every way, save for the fact that his face is as beautiful as that of an angel. Upon his head is a reddish orange and gold cap adorned with the exotic feathers of orange and yellow birds. He wears baggy and poofy pants alongside a shirt of similar fashion, sporting colors of scarlet and a dark yellow. Around his shoulders and neck is an emerald green scarf of great length, long enough to almost seem like a cape at times. His shoes are rather goofy, but are made of good quality leather.

A dark skinned young man, about 5'10 in a white combat tunic with a cloak and a large katana with a bronze grip. He has black hair and icy blue eyes, he typically has a mean look about him and always seems to be cold.
Story Summary:
* Aside from Backstory content, Desoka is just now joining the rest of the goldhearted on their adventures

* Is eager to fight alongside the goldhearted and has been training alot recently to prepare himself

Physical Description:
*Despina:*
5'2" (158 cm)
Curly red hair, shy of chin length
Brown eyes with rectangular pupils
Light brown skin
Spiraling sheep horns
Wooly red tail, fairly long (like an undocked sheep)
Dressed in a Gnosis Academy student's uniform: a pink-purple shirt with gold accents, sleeves flaring at the elbows, with a darker undershirt going to the wrists; a red sash bearing the insignia of the Regal House of Treasures; off-white pants; and oddly shaped boots on her hooves.

*ᵀʰᵉ Deliverance:*
A one-handed axe with a haft that looks to be made of a long femur, cracked at its bottom. It is wrapped with fabric with white and black stripes to make a handle.
The axe is largely dark black, shifting to dark grey as it starts narrowing to the cutting edge. Symbols are etched onto the blade that dully glow when she is using her token magic while in her core.
Rare Equipment: Regalia: 1-handed broadaxe (heavy melee), +1 accuracy, Lifesteal Quality
Story Summary:
* Humanoid born in Dreadlan to Lost parents who lived with a pack of Wild Souls (striped hyenas)
* Was the 'runt of the litter' but definitely loved and felt loved by her packmates
* Constantly tried hard to prove her worth, unlike her parents who were more hopeless, listless, just trying to get by
* One day her pack saw a lone human and the attempt to hunt them went poorly
* The human was a mage and killed a lot of the pack, including her parents
* The rest scattered, but she was seeing too much red to run
* He saw some use in a humanoid who still had a spark in her and so after forcing her to listen, made her an offer
* Desperate to cling on to life, she swallowed her pride and sorrow and agreed to be his servant and student, studying magic under him for the next few years
* Eventually his own patron proposed to send her off to Heartdom to get a Knight in their service
* Enrolled in the House of Treasures because she wants to be something stronger than a puny little human

Physical Description: Devon is a 5-foot, 5-inch king. His whole body has been modified to look like a tiger shark, complete with teeth, webs between his fingers, and a fairly long tail. He's got short black hair, coffee-colored irises and the back of his tan-and-sand body is lined with darker stripes all the way down his tail.

Class List: Floralist ★ /  Esper ★ / Loremaster ★ / Darkblade ★ / Tinkerer 3 / Orator 4 / Symbolist 3
Physical Description: Dhata stands at a little over 5'9", with a rather reedy build. Their skin is dotted with scuffs and bandages from past training injuries. They carry themself with a calm, focused demeanor, their inner turmoil all but settled.
Story Summary: see character bio

Physical Description: Flashily dressed scientist with pink/purple died hair constantly carrying gadgets
Story Summary:
-Parabellum field researcher
-Pirate Radio host
-Squatting in a super condemned mcmansion

Physical Description: Donovan is a tall, stocky, slightly intimidating human man dressed in plain religious vestments. On his shoulder he carries a long, golden cloth he uses in tandem with his fans for his performances. Despite his grey hair, he is, in his words, "29 years young".

6'5" and 200 lbs pale skin being with silver scales lining the sides of their head, neck, arms, torso and legs. Black wings expand from the back and silver horns protrude from their head. They have white strait hair. They wear a long combat tunic that looks like a trench coat and have high black boots. Shirt and pants underneath their tunic.
Dorian is an athletic human of slightly above average height from Kor'Tarion. He has black hair and brown eyes. Height 5'10" Weight 160 lbs
Lawrence is a shorter man, with pale ashy skin, and faded crimson eyes. His hair is a light gray and he wears a similarly toned suit. He has minimal skin showing, and simple metal jewelry.
Story Summary:
- Nearly twenty years ago, he took out a simple and manageable loan to open a pharmacy with a friend. However, not long after, just as the business was beginning to take a dip, the Baylore Company collapsed.
- His loan was now in the hands of ETA, and there was little he could do about it. In a stress-enduced bender one evening, Lawrence attempted to return home, intoxicated. Unaware, and delerious, - 
- Lawrence stepped out into traffic, and passed away. Since then, he's managed his pharmacy as a diligent, passionless worker, with glazed red eyes. ETA had returned him as an Insolvent, and he was now to work for the rest of days.

Physical Description:
A woman standing at a proud 5'7, Nüying is often dressed in training clothing, and her long black hair pulled back. She holds a bamboo staff that has lost its vibrancy of life but still has yet to have rot stick to it.

The tips of her fingers seem to have been stained black due to her cultivation though she holds such things as a point of pride rather than worry.
Story Summary:
- Born to a one of Xiexie’s servants, Nüying showed a promise for death cultivation quite young.
- Quickly Xiexie took Nüying under her wing and she became enamored by Xiexie’s gifts.
- Seeing the positives that not only came to her but her family as well under Xiexie’s praise, Nüying took to her training with more vigor than any would expect from someone her age. Any negative side affects of taking in so much death qi was waved off by her.
- Now with Xiexie’s guidance and training, Nüying would be proud of her skill but still strives for more.

Physical Description: 6:3 pumpkin headed man with an eternal lite in his eyes and mouth (literally) and eternal sinister smile. He is dressed in raggedy clothing with a cape and coat over his armor. The armor has a massive almost magical gash over its chest and a heart stitch where his heart SHOULD be. he has grafts over his body and clear stitching where he was sealed together
Rare Equipment: A riding horse (please dont kill ((YET))
Story Summary:
Soul defender of village from undead after father retired
Tried to fight a necromancer and lost
got his soul treasure stolen and put into a monster
Monsters creation killed necromancer
remembered old morals, a desire to help and do good
despite helping people, he was treated like a monster by fellow Kor'Tarians

Physical Description: Ebb stands roughly around 4' (121cm), and is vaguely shaped as a normal person. Where there would be eyes are faint motes of light, similar to dim stars in the night. Their form matches the color of the space between the stars, a deep blueish black. Coming from the top of their head is a pair of antenna like pieces of 'hair'. Flowing down past their waist is seeming white colored hair, though it fades off into nothingness instead of normal ends of hair.

A large red fox standing about 3' at shoulder-height and 5' long from nose to bushy tail. Distinguishable as a yokai from the soft golden glow of his eyes and the way wind seems to play a soft tune around him wherever he goes.
Rare Equipment:
Resonance Cuffs (World Saver Custom Arcane)

Medic's Cloak (When you cause one or more allies to recover Hit Points during a conflict, each of those allies gains Resistance to the next instance of physical damage they suffer before the start of your next turn. This benefit is not cumulative.)
Story Summary:
-Though granted sapience and power as a young kit, Echo holds no particular loyalties to any of the Aesir, including Kuzunoha. 
-His early life was marked by the same strife as countless other residents of Aldistir, crafting barriers in his heart that have remained strong into adulthood. 
-Having been born and raised on the outskirts of Camp Von Kibo, Echo was known to associate minimally with the Aldish and other yokai, preferring his solitude whenever possible.

Physical Description: 6'4" | 174 lbs | Blue Eyes
Story Summary:
- Edward Lowell Jr. (aka Ed) was born into Terra's 1%. He grew up in his mother's mansion in Billionaire's Row with his two older brothers. 
- While his life was pretty amazing growing up, it never felt like it was right. So although his brothers followed in their father's steps within the ET Corporation, Ed went off on his own to open up a small business. 
- The Million Mystery (aka Mystery Gang) is a private investigation company that looks into all sorts of information, specifically seemingly dead ends and supernatural requests. Charging affordable rates has caused his business to struggle, but with the help of his friends he's been able to keep it afloat. 
- He was subject to a kidnapping attempt after being blackmailed a few weeks ago, but a realmsgorm saved the day!
- Now, he's hopeful to discover the truths of Terra, and whatever realms Yubel calls him to!

Physical Description:
To the naked eye, Ekho resembles a green-skinned desert plant in the shape of a young woman, with black eyes and a stretched-out mouth, with a hair bun that allows this one to open their own head as one giant bulb.

Standing about five feet high, this one wears an old linen sack they were thrown in with, with a rope acting like a sash to hold some of their possessions, like water skins and seeds of "little ones". One may also spot this one with a wooden stake they use for movement, gardening and, occasionally, fending off hostile creatures.
Quirks:
Arboreal
- immune to **shaken**
- vulnerable to **ice**
- MP cost of Toxic Pollen reduced by 5 in sunlight

Physical Description:
Height: 160cm

Elaine is a blonde haired female presenting individual from Terra. Rather petite figure and a patch covering her right eye. Usually wears rather loose clothes and looks mostly unbothered by most things.
Story Summary:
* Traumatic Childhood that lead to her Psionic Powers
* Ran away from home. Stole Model from her father's account (works as an admin for SWORD games) 
* Lives in a van. Donates blood and plasma to support herself as well as working for 100G0

Class List:
Commander ☆
Tinkerer ☆
Wayfarer☆
Pilot ☆
Sharpshooter [3]
Arcanist [3]
Chimerist [2]
Physical Description:
Wilkin girl, 155cm (5'1") and 59kg (130lb).
Has a cool flying motorcycle called Percival.
Accompanied by a cooler cyborg crow called Quill.
Rare Equipment:
Multi on her cool Moonshard Railgun pistol
Physical Resistance armor or given to others on heal
Extra INS, FP on Discovery or Critical, Psionic Containment and Turning Leaflet
Story Summary:
- Orphaned and adopted by Caden Lockflint
- Raised to be a Magitech Engineer
- Latent unexplored magic made her fail Academy of Korala
- Sent out to become a mercenary with two full-metal animals
- Ended up at the Worldhelm a year ago
- Stayed mostly with Lhodos Goldhearted, both Merrani and Karlite
- Recently learned and accepted her past, unleashing her magic
- Abandoned the Lockflint name for Tika's Alksnis

Physical Description:
A lanky individual, a little over 6'1'' tall, with a face and body hidden inside an environmental isolation suit with a tabard, robes, and sigils atop, giving it the appearance of a strange mage's robes.

He carries a mechanized staff and a tome at his belt, as well as a wide variety of stimulants and medicine at his belt should his body begin to fail.
Story Summary:
- Born to human parents living outside the Civilized Zone. Very sickly youth.

- Extended family chose to get barcoded and move into the Civilized Zone for his medical care

- Elijah was unable to leave bed for more than brief periods. Expensive and difficult to keep Elijah alive.

- Watched as mother grew ill and died, and his father came to resent the burden that Elijah was.

- Visited by a recruiter who took interest and pulled strings to get him an Envirosuit for mobility and disease prevention

- Joins the recruiter and goes to Heartdom, recruiter wants him to join Regalia, but he chooses Paladins instead out of fear of changing that much.

Physical Description: A well built, 6' tall figure decked in full armor, distinguishable by the mighty anklers on his helm. His arms, though well-maintained, curiously lack any markings or emblems.
Eluna stands at 5'2" with silver hair, pointed ears and fangs. Most notably though is the faint fire the seems to dance in her the irises of her eyes that grows brighter as she sings.
Quirks: Outcast Fairy - Cannot refuse an encore to her singing or leave a song unfinished or else she will lose her voice. Until she is asked to sing without prompting or can soak in a flower petal infused bath.
Story Summary:
- Set out from her home looking to try and help make things better between fae and humans.
- Grew up in a village where singing is as second nature as breathing.
- Village did not fully support her goals, and doesn't wish to return until she has done so or has a very good reason.

Physical Description: Ember is a 6'5, bulky figure in maintenance gear suited for 0-G and Vacuum usage. His skin is a faded, darker grey with the classical glowing red eyes indicative of Insolvency for Terrans. His beard is trimmed but somewhat shaggy, as is his hair.
Story Summary:
- Came from a poor family
- Went into debt with ETA to get qualification through higher education
- Worked for Orrery for a long time, and finally got a chance to work in sub-orbital satellite maintenance through a work-visa for the Trans-Orbital Relocation Colum
- Skyfall destroyed many orbital structures, one of which he was working on
- He died, and was brought back as an Insolvent, and then got picked up by a realmstorm only days after

Physical Description: Emi is a short, pretty woman with medium length blonde hair, bright blue eyes, and a slight build. Her hair seems to be styled differently every other day, and always has some streak of bright pastel. Her wardrobe seems to be constantly shifting as well, though short skirts with fun patterns, thigh highs, jackets and crop tops are more common than anything else.
Story Summary: Emi is the first daughter of a well-to-do corporate family. Tired of the pressure and responsibility, she ran away from home when her uncle died, changed her name, and started a new life as a musician. She's been playing shows and trying to make a name for herself in Haven ever since.

Physical Description:
Emile can often be observed to be in a relatively calm state, typically either daydreaming or collecting his thoughts. He stands at roughly 5'6" tall, with his visage being mainly that of a canine with doberman-esque appearance and and eyes shimmering a pearlescent white. He is typically seen wearing either relatively casual streetwear or the uniform from his local law enforcement branch. A pretty striking point of interest though is the augmented mechanical left arm, with it's metallic construction readily visible.

When out on the field he can be seen with a blade attatched to his belt and vest. Leaving an impression of close combat being their preference.

Origin: Bingchuan Village, Jijing Xiantiao, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description: The Vanara stands just over 5 feet tall with a lean toned physique earned from laborious farmwork. Wears peasant clothing, a straw hat slung over his back and a stalk of grass in their mouth. Rarely seen without a smile on his face and a bottle in his hand.
Story Summary:
- Resident of Bingchuan village where he earned a living as an ordinary farmer, gifted with a green thumb (or just plain good luck)
- Befriended a Jinshi martialist, Yang Xiang, who exchanges cups over discussing the Dao of the Drunken Master
- A yokai invaded the village and ruined their hard-earned crop, inciting Enlai to chase it furiously
- He unwittingly crossed a realmstorm onto the Worldhelm, and wishes to experience the joys of a broader world

Physical Description: An unassuming grey-haired young man, often seen with a mercenary jacket, a longsword and katana at his hip, and carrying a book that looks strangely like communist paraphernalia.
Rare Equipment:
Kisshoten-Ichimonji (Heirloom)
Invites misfortune to its wielder out of combat, or summons sword-wielding enemies

Class List:
Spiritist 1
Ace of Cards ★
Fury 1
Orator 2
Physical Description:
Ephraim is a mercenary with an easygoing attitude. He stands at 5'11'' and has hair the color of tarnished bronze.

He can be seen playing with a shining gold coin that he always seems to have on him.
Rare Equipment:
House's Cards:
Once per scene, when resolving a set using the Magic Cards skill, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do so, you can treat any one of the cards in your hand as a joker.
Story Summary:
- An orphan bandit operating in the areas where Nezzim control was not so tight. Quit after a raid gone wrong became a village massacre.
- Captured and became slave to Nezzim masters. Eventually finds his way out of direct servitude and into 'working' for them instead, as a slave catcher.
- Becomes Goldhearted, and is shown a truth that the Nezzim and Humans share a common ancestry. Starts helping slaves escape from the Nezzim in secret.
- The Nezmiran Civil War against Theoris begins, and Ephraim throws in his lot with the Revolutionaries.

Character Sheet Link: ["Hey! Welcome in, what can I get started for ya? No, we don't have that on tap-"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mnw_5_iJcSS81vUy0zBVVFLCq5w1zaOfPruhyiW-SwA/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: A slim person with light brown skin, hair made white by their own choice, and a terrifyingly professional business sense of dress.
Quirks: Beta-Stage Efficiency Upgrader Spinal Implant (Fugitive Experiment)

Physical Description: Erin is a 5' 10 young woman with tan skin and shaggy brown hair. She is often seen in her uniform though it has the wear and tear of being in it when she is both training and working. A mechanical surfboard-esque thing is often slung over her shoulder that has become a staple for many who see her.
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in Steelbin's Civilized Zone with her older brother, Anthony Shephard. Their parents made their living being mechanics for Machina.
- The two siblings were raised to be skilled craftsmen and Anthony gained patronage to the Academy due to engineering skills. Anthony then brought attention to his younger sister Erin, who held the same promising skills but seemed more focused on using it on her own projects.
- Under Anthony's recommendation, Erin received the same patronage but was more eager at the chance to leave Steelbin behind than learning new skills.
- Erin has been a student now for two years and while her brother was a perfect student, she failed to meet those expectations so she focused on proceeding to do the bare minimum to stay enrolled and no more than that.

Physical Description:
Eris is a Faerie with many rabbit-like features standing at 4'1". Small, but with plenty of presence. She has dark skin and short, puffy white hair with springy rabbit ears poking out from the top of her head and deep green eyes. Her favorite attire for dancing is a flowing green two-piece cloth that leaves plenty of room for her to breath during her performances. A small, round fluffy rabbit tail sits on her lower back.
During her dances, she sprouts graceful white bird wings that seem to radiate with the colors of a peacock, leaving a torrent of feathers in their wake, like confetti during a celebration.
Story Summary:
• Lost from her family in the Fae Realm, wandered looking for them until being sent to the Ruined Kingdom

• Learned how to fight by a mentor in a town she stumbled upon, she used this talent to help the people bring light into the darkness of the realm.

• A Realmstorm suddenly hit her, losing another parental figure of hers. She goes on adventures to look for them and her birth family.

• She desires to bring peace, freedom, hope, and joy to any realms she visits.

Physical Description:
"An older human. Their face is ugly with age, but their lineaments still have a softness to them. Their white hair is usually messily tied back, and it is not uncommon to see them wear a beret or cap.
They are always dressed with modest clothing, kept to near perfection.
Their posture is usually weary and tense; could it simply be the weight of their years?
Strange, they only go by their first name."
Rare Equipment: \- **Arm-Mounted Cannon** [No Qualities]

Physical Description: Evelyn stands at 5'9" with their messy blue hair only tied up with the ponytail behind then. A eyepatch over one of their eyes as they dress in an almost ostentatiously and aggressively in pirate fashion.
A catboy with light red clothes and a fancy rapier at his side.

Fable is a little thing, still standing as tall as they can at 4' total (but they float to about 5'7", usually) A body, bleak as ink, is blotted with tufts of fluffy snow-white fur. Flanking each side of their head are two perky, long ears like a rabbits, and a crown of jagged horns like those of an upturned buck. A floofy white tail, like a wolves sways behind them, and their slender legs end in a pair of tiny paws. They are decorated with muted cloths of black, and blue, bits of armor and metal protecting important bits. A large, blue-green gem hangs off their neck on a thick loop.

In total shadow, their moony yellow eyes breach the dark, as do the ends of their horns, and the bases of their ears in an eerie white and violet glow.
Quirks:
Outcast Faerie
- Learned Spell: Drain Spirit
- Fae Weakness: Fable is unable to make willful contact with any iron or iron alloys unless it is to defend, save, or fight someone or something.
"Steel is not to be drawn, until it's purpose is to be fulfilled"

Physical Description: A smaller slightly wider woman with sparkly eyes and large poofy curly hair tied back with blue highlights in it. She is dressed as a lightning themed magical girl with slight Mechanical accessories, including her gloves that has her magispheres inside. She also has a cute little umbrella as her spellcasting implement
Story Summary:
Comes from a family of rich celebrities from terra
Fabri's mother, Vindi, working for NTT is trying to rebrand magic to become a face of a group and gain even more fame
This skyrocketed the family into even more celebrity status due to controversy
Vindi as part of a magical rebranding stunt claimed that her daughter was a spell caster
Fabri being her oldest child was set up as said spellcaster despite not being able to cast spells
Uncle teaches Fabri to create spells via magisphere
uses it to "fake it till she made it"
Vindi uses Fabri to try and push magic to be more "friendly and light hearted" to change public opinion
uses her connections to make Fabri a storm "superhero" as part of her brand
Fabri believes every word of it

Physical Description: Tall with a head of red hair like blood and fire, eyes that smolder like the inside of a volcano. Red scales lineing different parts of her body in clusters from her scaled and clawed hands and around her neck. Two black horns coming from the top that curve and curl into sharpened points along with large black wings that sprout out from the back. She stands at 6'3 normally, constantly radiating warmth and at times under certain situations smells of blood.

A quite effeminate young man with a lithe build, Fang stands at around 5’4” and 102 lbs. A pair of canine ears poke above a head of light auburn hair, tied back in a ‘stylishly unkempt’ ponytail and pigtails combo. A matching tail often swishes eagerly below any number of cute outfits, many of which were tailored by Fang himself.
He often wears a pair of odd gloves: stylish, but with a dull humming of magitech woven through the fabric that allows him to manipulate the small blades he utilizes in both dressmaking and combat.

Pale skin and white hair due to the color being drained from them. Dresses modestly with most of her body covered and has an eye patch over her right eye. Seems to wear several flowers in her hair. But with close impaction or high observation skills can tell those flowers are actually growing from her body.
Rare Equipment:
Ebonlight Vesture - Otherworldly Veil Runic Armor
Fernia's Parasol - Swordbreaker Runic Shield
Frozen Spark Lantern - Dual Resistance (Ice/Bolt) Runic Shield
Floracord Pendant - Kindred Accessory
Story Summary:
- Was a simple traveling botanist studying plants.
- Got rumors of strange flowers showing up in the Irathwood and went to investigate.
- While looking for the flowers in the rumors she was attacked by something and blacked out.
- When she awoke she found a flowering plant she did not know had begun growing on her and was holding her injuries together.
- When trying to remove the plant she was inflicted with intense pain that caused her to almost pass out. When she does things this bloom seems displeased with it causes her pain or discomfort.
- Over time the color in her hair and skin began to fade turning white and becoming pale.

Physical Description:
Height: 5'11" Eyes: Red
Weight: 195 lbs Hair: Light Red
Chest has a scar from his first battle against monsters. It is in the form of 3 claw marks.
An average height individual of slim build adorned in "stylish" attire ,and pale hair
A man who has purple leaves instead of hair. Roots can be seen growing within parts of his skin. He wears a large cloak and long sleeves - likely to hide his unconventional appearance from others.
Quirks:
The Long Dream
At the end of each session (approximately four hours of play), before assigning XP, roll 2d20. If you roll equal to or lower than your current character level, the last farewell grows closer. When a rule or ability requires you to spend Hit Points, Mind Points, or Fabula Points, you may instead ignore that cost. If you do, the last farewell grows closer; after you ignore a cost this way, if the last farewell has grown closer at least 10 times, the moment has come to leave the world of humans.

Physical Description: Moderately tall, and wiry for a would-be soldier, Florian dresses in a variety of well-tailored paints and vests with a long formal coat. Soft leather boots, suited for hiking, are the only part of his outfit that would suggest he was anything different than the average Merrani young noble or academy student. Wearing glasses over green eyes, his intricate staff and a crystal amulet tucked under his vest are the only weapons and/or magitech visible.

Flynn stands roughly around 5'5 (165cm), decorated in noble styled clothing and different jewelry. On top of his head is a pair of cat ears with tuffs of fluff coming out of them. A large, fluffy tail that often tucked beneath his cloak. His hair a natural blonde, being normally unkempt despite his best efforts. An aura of confidence and chivalry comes from him and his actions. A smile always present on his face.
Rare Equipment:
**Heartache:** - Status Plus (Poison) 
**Sunburn:** - Status Plus (Enraged)
**Duet's Finale:** - World Savior
**Bonded Bracelets:** - With Orion
**Petals of Matrimony**
**Duet's Accompaniment:** Lion's Health
Story Summary:
-Born and raised in Tradefair to a poor family
-Worked under a noble family as their servant and learned to dance there
-Left the house when he came of age and worked as a mercenary against L.U.T
-Now is apart of the Trueheart Coalition and working to become a noble in Tradefair
-Doesn't have his soul treasure, has his past lover's soul treasure inside him instead

Physical Description: A six foot lean androgynous person, covered all over in white feathers with two large white wings on their back. They have clothing that covers part of their head and neck. Their chest is mostly exposed (they have a male body) and they have a skirt made out of their own feathers down to knee length. They have bird like claws instead of hands and feet.

A slender creature with a vague humanoid shape, with dark green rubbery skin, long messy hair, and bug, white, unblinking eyes. Pink markings reminding of demonic seals traverse their body.

They tend to stare silently at people, communicating through magically conjured pieces of written paper in fear of their voices. When they do speak, they do so in the voices of those the listener left behind in their life.

They aren't very expressive, but anyone getting too close may feel their self loathing in the air...

Leadhearted Fae (modified Fettered Heart)

- **Never** let anyone else steal the spotlight
- **Always** repay an insult

Rules broken 4/7 times

Story Summary:
- The current incarnation of the demon of Envy, whose essence was tampered with by the Dream Weaver to create something less dangerous
- They spent 72 years claiming a semblance of humanity, eventually making a name for themselves as Gabu, protector of the Mirland Coast
- Eventually, to save a friend they turned back into their old form, regaining their more demonic and envious persona. They are however trying to be better.

Physical Description:
Gaius is of average high, but is obviously quite fit. His mid length hair is a wavy, dirty blonde and the most striking feature of his face are the odd-coloured eyes. One is brown and one is blue. He tends to wear rather light clothes under his armour and when he can he at least carries his weapon everywhere, but quite often he can be seen with his shield as well. 
While he often looks serious or even anguished, he has a light smile and a friendly demeanour once people talk to him, which can clash with his martial appearance.
Rare Equipment: None
Story Summary: Originally born in Last Hold, Gaius came into contact with several key aspects of the Culture of the empire early on: Being oppressed due to being a human, the branding and exploitation of mages and the hunters, going out into the desert to cull the Kiir. All of this has influenced him to go out into the desert himself, to escape the constant oppression, but also to hide his nascent magical abilities from the Nezzim. He became a skilled hunter relatively fast, but much changed when he stumbled upon an old stone tablet, talking about Falak-khan in the Short Peaks. He had heard rumours of this god in the past, but was now completely fascinated with him.  Nowadays, he's wandering the dunes, trying to find a sign of this god to enkindle the spirits of his fellow oppressed  against the Nezzim. To this end, he's seeking out everybody who might know more about the ancient stories, but also talking to other people, especially hunters, to slowly spread the tales and a hope for a new dawn.

Physical Description: Gareth is tall and pale blonde, with tan skin and dark eyes. He dresses in light layers and carries everything  he owns in a bag strung over his shoulders.
Story Summary:
He has lived in Idyll for as long as he can remember. He was originally born on Terra, but the memory has faded such that he doesn't know what his life there was like. He doesn't even remember how long he'd been in Barza when he met Mya. She was exactly what he needed to face the layers of Idyll-- quick and decisive when he was uncertain, ruthless and cutting when he was gentle. They made a good team. They made their way down over the course of years, until Gareth could scarcely remember a time before he had Mya. Down they went, layer by layer, until they got stuck in the sands of Sum. And when she hardened too much, when she turned to stone... he couldn't lose that. 
For the last two years, Gareth has been painstakingly moving Mya's statue with him through the sand. He is determined to find a way to fix her and bring her with him when he finally escapes Idyll for good.

Physical Description:
Gianna stands at 5'11'', carrying herself proudly and elegantly with a stylish walking cane she retains from a period of struggle. She can be usually seen in a maid's attire, complete with even an apron filled with pockets where she keeps all sorts of useful stuff. Lately, she picked up on dressing with more casual clothes, too. Whatever her outfit, she always wears her magical gauntlet, since it tends to react violently when separated from her.
Brown eyes, brown hair kept loose that seem to be burning at the tips

- Former factotum at her family's inn in Lhodos' Northern Tundra, eventually her house/inn got burned down by unknown people
- Before going back to try and save the family from the burning building, her father handed her the family heirloom, a magitech gauntlet
- She tried to save her family herself, but failed and is saved from certain death by a realmstorm
- During her time as a hero, she discovered she can cast magic on her own. She's still unsure how to feel about it

Physical Description:
Haughty looking 6'0" guy in shiny armor and a big shield.

In fights, he uses wide range aura magic that comes from his body, usually star-shaped through intentional effort.
Rare Equipment: Recover 5 MP on attack, Mindful and +2 SL on Resonance
Story Summary:
- Only son of a family of corrupt merchants in Brightshield that hates mages
- Learned magic despite parents disapproval, they cause an accident and blame him for it, forcing him to abandon magic for years
- Renounces his name after discovering what happened, becoming a "hero" and a failed mercenary
- __Ends up at the Worldhelm__
- Gets involved with the Yokai of Aldistir due to Sakura
- Works as a mercenary in Kor'Tarion and has to deal with Rosalia
- Grows close to Dai Shuye and works with Gin to save her
