Physical Description: Grimalkin II is reminescent of a calico cat (albeit much larger), with the apparant mannerisms of housecat. The similarities stop there however, as Grimalkin II now walks on his hind legs for most of his immediate travel, he dawns a colorful cloak as a form of attire, and his tail is split in two at the base. When in his beastial form, Grimalkin II returns to his quadrapedal stride, and his body grows in proportion to that of a true coeurl (9 feet long, 600lbs).
Story Summary:
- A young cat yokai that has lost his mama
- Lived all around the forests of Aldistir
- Became blessed with speech by Kuzunoha one day
- Subsequently whisked away to the Worldhelm while searching for his mother, Grimalkin I

Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Jijing Xiantiao, Bingchuan
Physical Description:
A dark skinned and tall man, bearing clothing of Tian Yin, specifically that of Wujing Guo. Loose and open robes along with more martially inclined clothing. Underneath these robes a more tight black outfit that hugs his body. Lion like ears sprouting from his head and a lion's tail flicking behind him. His eyes bear with them an animalistic look, his expression is usually calm or a tame smile. His body denotes one who relies on strength, having more of a "strong man's" build rather than one aesthetically please. Heavy and dense muscles lining his body from top to bottom. On top of his clothing he wears what looks like hand-made jewelry.

When he is fighting, on occasion scarlet red blood can be seen as he uses his very own blood as a form of cultivation. The energy itself being derived from both Wood & Water Qi, a crimson hue that matches his hair.
Quirks: Hunted Emissary - Boon of Self Perfection - Natural Weapon [MIG+DEX+1]
Story Summary:
- Born to a human mother and Cultivator father within Bingchuan Village. Marriage was unhappy, father abusive/prone to anger.
- Mother prayed to the God Li Jing, bearer of the hundred-tiered pagoda and god of protection. Desiring a son who would protect her from her partner and the village as a whole.
- Born a Jinshi with an innate connection to Blood Cultivation, a mixture of Wood & Water Qi.
- Raised into a protector of the village alongside other Jinshi.
- Upon being older, discovered his father was indulging in Corrupt Cultivation through cannibalism in secret.
- Had him thrown out to safeguard the village.
- Recently buried his mother as she succumbed to old age.

Physical Description:
Taller than most. Carrying a larger axe than most. Eats more than most. What isn't clad in armor is her face. She wants to assure others that she isn't a threat.

Smiles often. Laughs even more.
Story Summary:
* Found in a basket, fished out of the ocean by fishers in Traeth Village.
* Grew up taller, stronger, much hungrier than a normal person.
* Took up the axe and armor to be the local guardian of Traeth.
* Inspired by the acts of heroism spreading throughout the realm, leaves to help who she can.

Origin: Tian Yin, Leytik, Temple of Strife
Physical Description:
A woman with a tan complexion, orange hair, and golden eyes. Her skin is covered in scriptures that shine in a golden light, enumerating the twenty-five postulates of the Golden Spiral Circulation and Harmonic Spiral Circulation, the sacred texts she has taken onto herself to master and one day teach. Her clothing is a mixture of Terran streetwear and traditional Leytik Empty Monk robes, decorated with accessories from her travels.
She doesn't seem to always fit perfectly well in social situations, sometimes looking weird, rude or insensitive as a result, but she knows people don't always like this aspect of her and she respects that.
Her methods of cultivation are likewise odd and unusual, especially for a supposed Empty Monk, as she relies on imposing her own flow over things rather than annihilating her own Qi and presence.
Quirks:
**Cultivator (Heavenly Qi)**
- You gain resistance to Light. Additionally, whenever you deal damage, you may change its type to Light. However, you also become Vulnerable to Dark.
- You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the Arcanism discipline with the domain of Order

- She grew up as a monk in the Temple of Strife, absolutely hating every moment of it
- Eventually, she decided to make it a problem to the monks, getting known as the biggest nuisance to the resident Lama
- At one point, she discovered a passion for math and physics, steering her cultivation towards this knowledge and body cultivation, developing her own very odd dao and demonstrating a natural inclination towards Heavenly Qi
- During her adventures on Terra she had her soul partially digitalized, but she managed to include that in her cultivation basis
- Breaking through to a new level of cultivation she inherited the Harmonic Spiral and vowed to claim the Temple of Strife

Origin: Tian Yin - Wujing Guo, Secret Fern Village
Physical Description: With a body mostly covered in shimmering scales the color of sapphires, he possesses luxurious white hair which winds down his back and along the thin tail behind him. Additional lengthy tufts at his elbows and knees lend a gentle countenance to him, reflected with his equine-esque face, plated ridges along the bridge of his nose leading to a single antler-horn arcing gracefully from the middle of his forehead.
Story Summary: Haoran used to be a dancer in his village, but was chosen as a sacrifice to the Beast King. He fled and ended up on the Worldhelm.

Physical Description:
183 cm tall, average build

Usually seen in silver armor with blue accents covering his whole body, especially the helmet. Even without it he usually wears clothes with long sleeves and high collars.

His body is covered with ugly scars that glow and buzz with elemental energies, which is why he prefers to keep himself hidden beneath armor. His hair is green, short and unkept, his pale skin has strange green tinge to it that makes him appear sickly, his face seems to have settled into a permanent frown, and his nose looks like it got broken and healed improperly. His eyes too glow with elemental energies, changing colors with his surroundings, and his Heterochromia is the only part of his looks that he actually likes.
Story Summary:
- Believed in Merrane propaganda, wanted to join the army
- Got dragged into human experimentation
- Survived, gained Elemental powers
- Was to be tested on the battlefield, saw the reality of the war, deserted, managed to escape
- Became Goldhearted while planning to fight against the Empire

He also has a notable scar across his left cheek and lips.

Story Summary:
- His people are warriors that revere the Dragonlords; especially Sumi'shna
- Studied the ancient art of the Dragoons and fought in the Colosseum of the Ancient Dunes
- Has known only peace and prosperity, but fights to liberate the enslaved of Nezmira
- Stays aboard the Worldhelm so that he may better serve the realms, and so that he may gather the strength he needs to effect a change in Nezmira
- Soulbonded with the last vestige of love from Dragonlord Sumi'shna: the white and gold wyvern, Phaethon

Physical Description:
Hiya Salamin is a boyish Bakla standing at a meek 5'4. She has a small frame with lightly discolored hands from the labor of glassblowing. She prefers comfortable clothes that do well to insulate her skin to the sweltering heat. She has two orange irises and black hair.

She does battle using a glass construct she calls Pagninilay, that resembles one of the four auspicious beasts, the beast of summer. It has red stained glass feathers and crystal clear complexion.
Story Summary:
• Born to a lineage of glass cultivators in Pagapalay Village, a village at the base of Mt Magayon.

• She grew up under the tutelage of the fire cultivators and her father in spite. Because she was born a man, and is currently a Bakla. She didn't receive the same opportunities as her mother did.

• She was trained in both alchemy and general medicinal expertise as well, being trained to be partly a guide amongst the volcano with her fire ki.

• She carries a urn that was an heirloom passed down from generations, carrying molten glass that she can control.

Origin: Realm of Tian Yian, Sub Realm of Tei Sei, village of Hanae
Physical Description: Horoko isn't outwardly a terribly intimidating presence. She is calm and quiet, often seen smiling when not in the middle of a battle. She wears a simple blue kimono and hakama, and carries a rather nondescript katana at her left hip. She'd almost be easy to miss if not for the striking white hair and icey blue eyes that make even her smile just a little disconcerting. Still, she seems harmless enough, and her light, cheerful voice always speaks words of encouragement and cheer.
Rare Equipment:
Senbonzakura (Katana w/ Multi)
Katon's Katana (Katana w/ Undodgeable)
Yami to Hikari (Katana w/ Inexorable Strike)
Story Summary:
* Was found in Hanae at roughly 4 years old with no memory of parents.
* Original guardians were disappeared. She became a vagrant.
* Was kicked out of Hanae during a food shortage :(
* Was found in the forests by Musashi!
* Trained by Musashi
* Returned to Hanae 4 years later
* Had helped keep the village safe in exchange for shelter
* Yoinked by the Worldhelm while scouting the forests.

Physical Description: Standing at 10'5 wearing what most would consider rags or basic leather armor eitched with runes and markers. Brown fur with spots of reds mostly around the head with a small puff of jet black hair at the top.

Hua Ying stands at a respectable 5'5" (horns and okobo included), paired with her slender and androgynous build people foolishly assume her to be younger than she actually is, much to her ire. For the sake of her pride she goes to great lengths to combat these assumptions, painstakingly curating every aspect of her appearance and the way she is perceived by others, making a point to always carry herself in a dignified and sophisticated manner.

In these efforts she takes special care of her hair horns and tail, despite the latter's constant betrayal of her emotions at inopportune situations.
Story Summary:
✦She was born and partly raised in Bingchuan by her adoptive father who taught her the art of cultivation. 

✦With each passing year her father grew more desperate to reach the peak of cultivation that his ancestors once did, causing them to isolate themselves from the village as their training became ever harsher.

✦One fateful day on a pilgrimage to Xiaohai she was suddenly attacked by her father, beaten within an inch of her life and left for dead.

✦Though she managed to survive she became a husk of her former self, now consumed with a burning doubt. She strives to learn the reason behind her father's change and will do so at any cost.

Physical Description: A humanoid-looking 6'8 creature, their body itself has little to no color. Their hair though often times swirls with different hues and shades of color that they pull from for their art. The only thing that seems human being stray articles of clothing they have picked up over the years simply because "they looked nice."

Physical Description:
Standing at 5'10" and weighing 145 lbs, Huong Jin boasts a slender but defined figure with feminine features, which they proudly boast through the crimson flak jacket, simple brown pants with a belt that stores their infusion ampules, and some leather boots made for kicking. They sport medium-length black hair, ruby red eyes and pointy ears.

A couple of braces contain Malice and Mayhem - the twin gauntlets that act as their self-forged weapon of choice, which are fed by the various ampules they carry on their belt.

Story Summary:
- Lived in Hedgeburg doing odd jobs during their college years
- Had a rough childhood due to poor parenting, may as well be adopted
- Learned alchemy and chemistry during school and nurse side hustle, took on engineering based on their missing father's notes (or they think it's him)
- Despite all, worked in the lab built in the shed till it blew up and the Realmstorm sucked them in
- Co-founded The Future's Anvil, built their own warehouse called JR&D
- Ended up in a relationship with Gianna Tomaris
- Joined the Goldhearted Court as a fully-fledged fae

Physical Description: Normally seen in wooden armor, Hydrangea is a 5'8" collection of plants in the shape of an average human woman. Most of her leaves are a bright green in colour that get lighter in the face, with a large flower on her head that changes based on which magiseed she is using. She has short "hair" black eyes and a mouth with noticeable fangs. She is normally seen with a hopeful smile across her face.
Tall, Silver-eyed lady with blue eyes. Often gazing at the horizon when lost in thought.

Icarus is a very slender, young man with a permanent grimace towards the world. He moves with a graceful precision, and his fierce golden eyes convey a sense that he is always intently focusing on something about to happen. He has light skin, and even lighter, platinum blonde hair. When fully clothed in his traditional Terran streetwear, one would not be remiss to assume him to be a perfectly normal human being. However, when exposed, one can see transluscent feathers erupting from the skin on his forearms and calves. These are a mark of his experimentation, and he hides them at all costs, ashamed that they remind him of failure.
Story Summary:
- A "failed" experiment, created by a scientific collaboration between NTTech and DHK Heavy Industries.
- Left to die in NTTech Territories, but managed to survive despite the odds.
- Part human, part avian DNA with apparent Esper abilities.
- Worked as an assassin-for-hire as part of the Vignettes.
- Discovered his own humanity when deciding to decline a hit on children.
- Hunted down by the Vignettes, but suddenly appeared on the Worldhelm.
- Dreams of one day opening up an orphanage.

Physical Description: At a mere 4’7”, the oversized merchant backpack Ineza carries around with her only serves to help make her look even smaller. Sporting bright red scales and the piercing eyes of a saleswoman always ready to make a deal, her practiced grin is about equally likely to bring comfort as it is mild suspicion.
Rare Equipment: Mom’s Old Pack (Heirloom)

Physical Description: A Terran with brown hair with a black and blue aesthetic wearing armor similar to what an android would look like. Often carrying around a railgun under his big cloak. His armor seems flexible to where even his helmet asks more as a mask with how it comes on and off with a simple press of a button.
Story Summary: Born and raised in a small town in Terra his life was immediately ruined by his parents overbearing nature which caused him to resent and despise them with no access to any entertainment. One way or another he eventually found out about twinworld and was enamored with its style and mechanics. He decided one day that this was the life for him so he left home and decided to work for sword to both earn a living, get a T.E.M.P. License and save enough money to be able to play triworld. Casually walking the streets looking like a warrior Ioes is nothing more than a huge nerd for a game he’s really really into, so into in fact that even his cosplay is considered military grade.

Class List:
Weaponmaster Lvl 2
Arcanist Lvl 2
Entropist Lvl 1
Physical Description: She stands at 5'8, carrying herself with unwavering pride, her stance firm and assured. Once a deep, natural black, her hair now bears a striking lavender hue. A permanent mark of her ordeal. She wears a modified off-the-shoulder yukata, tailored for combat, blending elegance with practicality. A simple black eyepatch conceals her ruined eye, a silent testament to the day the beneath the rain.
Quirks:
Flight
You are able to fly. In addition to the obvious advantage in mobility, your melee attacks can target flying creatures and you cannot be targeted by melee attacks unless the attacker is flying or is somehow able to reach flying targets.

While in Crisis or unable to fly freely (such as when you’re inside a vehicle designed for human-sized creatures or in a narrow corridor), you lose all benefits granted by this Quirk. 

Additionally, when you suffer air, bolt or ice damage during a conflict scene, you lose the benefits of this Quirk until the start of your next turn. [Flavored as lightning stepping, teleporting with lightning, moving through metal as lightning, etc.]
Story Summary:
Born into the Hirose Clan, Iori was destined for a life of silk and servitude, but her father defied tradition, to forge her into a warrior. In Sakai, even daughters bore steel, and she was no fragile flower. She was a rose with thorns, both beautiful and deadly. When the Oni came, the capital fell, the emperor was slain, and the samurai, refusing to kneel, waged one final battle. Beneath a rain-darkened sky, they were defeated. Ready to die, Iori was instead forced to flee by her father, carrying the shame of survival.

Beneath the raging storm, she cursed the gods, demanding a reason for her survival. And one answered. Lightning struck, searing through her, leaving power thrumming in her veins. When she awoke, she was changed. Now she is a Rōnin. A wandering blade with no master, no home, and a single vow. Never again would she bow to an emperor, never again serve a noble. Her sword would be sworn only to a cause worth dying for.

Physical Description: Iris is a 6:3 thin rail of a woman with the look of failure that can be easily spotted under the bags under her eyes. She has long black curly hair that looks unkempt and is over one of her eyes. she is wearing black leathers with a hunters skirt over her legs and riding boots, both with old insignia scratched out. around her wrists and her neck is a large thorned vine that moves on its own. the ones around the wrists curl up to the elbows and the ones around her neck dangle down like a danger scarf with a blue bleeding heart flower that hangs lie a tie in front of her
Story Summary:
Parents made a trade and cost Iris her freedom
had to work for a hivemind fae group to capture other people
was forced to be a slaver for a while and hated it
became a Kor'Tarian folk tale
Gold hearted did a hostage rescue and broke out a bunch of people
Iris used this confusion to break free and sneak onto a realmsplitter
it did not spit her out because she is a gold hearted and couldnt be teleported because of fae stuff

Physical Description:
A muscular woman standing at 6' even. She has multiple piercings, tattoos, and scars, and its often indistinct which is which.

She wears simple clothing, usually favoring styles that fit lightly or that leave her arms bare. She moves with an easygoing confidence, though it is harder to read her expressions on account of her yellow, catlike eyes.

Earthly Phase: Earth
Rituals involving earth/rocks
Damage may be changed to Earth
Vulnerable to Poison (Wood)
Story Summary:
-Born in Tangbawan to the sister of a Matriarch, making her the Matriarch's niece.

-As a child, she was older and more skilled at cultivation than her cousin, the Matriarch's daughter. So, the Matriarch wants her out of the picture in order to secure succession.

-At 12, she is taken from her family and given to the Kabiya. She's old enough to understand why this is happening and is bitter about it.

-Lives among the Kabiya, learning how to survive the dangerous wilderness. Focuses on cultivation and self-reliance rather than trusting people.

Ignacio stands at 390cm (13') as a griffin of the twilight. His upper body is similar to an eagle with black, shimmering feathers while the hindside is that of a lion. Despite the black feathers, there is a hint of radiance from the griffin.

- Earliest memory is surviving in the slums as a child.
- Rescued a poached griffin while stowing away in a merchant caravan.
- Raised by the Witch of the Jarwood alongside the griffin, Ignacio.
- Reintegrated into Tradefair under the Helping Hands guild, gaining renown as fearless couriers tackling extreme conditions.
- Earned heroic recognition for aiding Hafod (Midday Sun) and Doana Village (development & Night of the Red Sky defense).
- Knighted in Brightshield on ‘Knight’s Day’ during King Marcello’s coronation.

Physical Description: Tall, and with a body that shows clear signs of a physical life, one spent fighting. Those that knew her before would notice her slightly more angular features, and how her naturally tanned skin has grown ashy and pale from extended lack of sunlight.
Story Summary: Isobel, a wolf of the Ashwynd family, the heir to the legacy, or at least she was. But now she's been claimed by the Worldhelm, and has returned - changed. Can she find a cure or a way to channel these abilities to be worthy of going home? Will she find a new family in the mean time?

Physical Description: A young woman often seen with a warm smile and a relaxed posture. She has short, wavy platinum hair that has been seemingly dyed mint-green at the ends and bright green eyes. Her outfit consists of a long-sleeved uniform sweater with the Regal House of Warden's emblem on the chest, layered over a dark high-collared shirt and vest. Like many other Kaiway students, an armored pauldron rests on her right shoulder. She also wears a dark brown skirt over tights and lace-up boots.
Quirks:
Outcast Fairy
Weakness: **Isolde has a fading presence. Someone who should remember her suddenly struggles to recall details about her, even in the middle of an interaction. They might forget her name, her role, or why she's even there, causing confusion or hesitation. Villains are not affected and Kaiway Students/Goldhearted are resistant.**
Rare Equipment:

Story Summary:
- Was found in Heartdom as a child and adopted by a Paladin + Regalia, raised with the expectation that she would one day follow in their footsteps.
- Is a fey-adjacent child, existing in an unstable state—she is slowly fading from memory, unable to form lasting bonds with others.
- Her adoptive parents can remember her, and their unwavering love and support have kept her spirits high, even as the rest of the world finds it hard to remember her.
- She was denied the chance to become a Regal Vessel due to her affliction, as she cannot bond with a partner.
- The Headmaster is also a person who can completely remember her, though they have never explained why.
- With no other path forward, she remains at Gnosis Academy, placed in a remedial class as she searches for a way to anchor herself in reality.

Physical Description: At 6'0", Jacomo is moderately tall, but exceedingly thin. In fact, his presence often goes unnoticed despite his statue; something that he often uses to his advantage. His hair is a raven shade of black, and his eyes are a dull crimson hue. He dresses in dark robes, which conceal the many surprises he has up his sleeve.
Story Summary:
- Hidela Academy drop out, and overall hooligan.
- Penchant for flirting and pranks
- Attempted a very high level ritual which failed
- Ripped from space and time; saved by Antikythera
- Currently fading from existence

Origin: The Realm of Aldistir, Camp Von Kibo
Physical Description: A 6’ 2” man wearing a suit of armor that covers every inch of their body. When their armor comes off it’s easy to see their several scars and golden blond body hair. Their helmet however, never comes off.
Story Summary:
• Known as a proficient warrior and terrifying adversary back in his homeland under a name he no longer claims as his own.

• Left his homeland after a terrible battle where he was the only survivor. This lead him to see the errors of his ways while beginning to learn to protect rather than destroy.

• Lives his life through kindness instead of hate being friendly to all and accepting people despite their flaws. Still refuses to ever talk about their past.

Physical Description: Jiafei is a just under six foot tall thinly built man. He has a mane of thick white hair that frames his face, and falls far down his back to nearly his knees. His two lion ears flick side to side passively at each noise or voice.
Story Summary: The only member of this generation of his family of guardians who had protected the Jijing Xiantiao for as long as they've been around. While normally they have many children, which all train to be powerful warriors, the hard times of the recent century have limited offspring. Only Jiafei has managed to survive to adulthood. Despite this, he fails to live up to his families warrior reputation, and has been cast aside by the common people as the end of his lineage. The Lanying family has lost it's prestige.

Physical Description: Jodi's curly short black hair frames a pale and unemotional countenance. She wears overalls with Tubal & Cain's logo, has a toolbelt and miscellany around her waist. Often has coffee to hand. She lives in a battered old helicopter, which doubles as her workshop.
Story Summary:
- Talented engineer from a young age with a promising future, ended up working at Tubal & Cain for weapons development.
- Awakened to psychic powers mysteriously one day. Jodi became disillusioned with their life and their work which supports war and Terra's status quo. Felt the need to make a change.
- Began procuring military supplies, gadgets from T&C contacts. A decommissioned heli falls into their possession before being scrapped. Wanting something new that breaks their stifling routine, Jodi works on it, renovating most of the passenger bay into a workshop/sleeping area where they now live.
- About six months into this phase of Jodi's life of adjusting to psychic powers, they find themselves on the Worldhelm. Is this a second chance to do good?

Physical Description: A tiny woman, she stands at 4'11 and has a very lithe, lean body that contorts well. There aren't any major blemishes in her skin, although she does carry a few scars beneath her cloak from close calls. She has bright orange hair and always has a stupid smirk on her face
A lanky man with long red hair pulled into a short braid with a rapier and parry dagger sheathed over a long coat.
Story Summary:
*Used to be a full time detective
*Took up the blade to fight against those who get away with crime thanks to money/corruption
*Breaks into houses under the guise of the Night Thief Dismas comiting the perfect robberies
*Strong sense of justice and abhorrence for murder

Physical Description: Verstappen is a tall woman with an imposing, almost oppressive presence. Her long blonde hair is kept practical, usually tied in a high bun to not interfere with her duties. Despite the wear and tear on them both, her plate armor and weapon are immaculately well maintained, serving both a practical purpose and steadfast devotion to her lord. There are a striking pair of black wings on her back, though they are not majestic and regal in any way. They’re scarred and covered in burn marks. Her glowing crimson eyes have returned, shining fiercely bright. They easily show whatever emotion she may be wearing.
Quirks:
Idyllic Soul (Angel)
- Due to her connection and loyalty to Lilith, Verstappen cannot disobey a direct order from Lilith or any angel above her own station. Doing so will severely weaken her both physically and mentally and in extreme cases, outright no longer make her an angel.

Story Summary:
- Died and went to Idyll, where she spent her time wandering the fields of Hinno
- After the corruption started to spread, she picked up a sword and began to defend those that couldn't do it themselves, joining up with the Caravans
- Was given the choice to become an Angel and defend the Caravans or to rest in Nirve
- Arrived onto the worldhelm and lost her soul treasure after an excursion to a Temple of Banshee in Kor'Tarion, and later experienced Ego Death
- Had a ritual to give her emotions again, albeit volatile.
- Has reclaimed her soul treasure and made whole.

3'8" (112 cm) tall

Orange eyes with distinctive 'bar' pupils

Long, shaggy grey hair

Pale greyish skin, getting progressively greener in her extremities

Dresses in practical, worn clothing, fairly covered up; fit for the desert. Has a big, wide-brimmed hat. Looks so much like a witch.
Rare Equipment: Formulaic Accessory (Roll +1 dice when using Alchemy)
Story Summary:
* A septid who grew up in a random dying podunk in the deserts of Central.

* Her mother was formerly with NT-Tech working in the Old World, and Katya grew up as an NTT booster who loved the sound of nature. Something went down and had her uproot so drastically. Her other mom had grown up in a Septid slum, and went to Central as a step up, whoof.

* Likes scrap and fiddling with things, doing repairs and kludges. Especially loves working with plants and medicines, got real good at it.

* Found a weird engineered snake somebody had dumped after their exotic pet got too big to be cute anymore. Named her Kelly. Quickly became inseparable.

* Her mom had some unburnt connections good enough to help get Katya a TEMP license from NTT.

* Did a bit of travel around Central, selling things and doing repairs, trying to make a living and also breathe some life back into her home and places like it.

Physical Description:
Kazuko Imaya certainly dresses the part of a punk. Leather jackets? Check. Spikes? Check. Pants that don't have extraneous holes? What are you, a cop?

She is tall at 5'9 and rather curvy. Her long hair is often in a ponytail, though some times she'll let it flow down to her waist. She's attractive, she's spunky. And she's down to rouse people into a fucking fight.
Story Summary:
* Born in Haven.
* Parents worked for DHK. DHK gave them a discounted rate to get Kazuko the trans related surgeries that she needed (yay!)
* But they couldn't pay the debts and were disappeared (Not yay :( )
* Kazuko got mad and started singing about it.
* Became a minor celebrity among the disenfranchized. Sings her heart out about her anger, regardless of its actual justification.
* Got bamfed to the worldhelm to fight for those who can't fight for themselves.

Physical Description: Keiko is a tall woman wearing colorful clothes and a bright expression.  She carries a sword in a lavender sheath and moves with exceptional grace.  A small scar crosses her nose, and she has an almost permanent smile on her face.
Story Summary:
-After her sister killed everyone in their village, Keiko searches for vengeance.
-Failing her lover Horoko in battle, her heart no longer glows in Tian Yin
-She managed to find her sister and save her from becoming corrupt, she became a Goldhearted

Physical Description: Keith is a very tall dark brown-skinned man at 200cm (6'6") with his hair braided in cornrows. He is often with a black hooded jacket, a green undershirt, gold chained necklace, and a pair of black slacks.

Story Summary:
- His life prior to the experimentations remain a mystery due to all traces of his life wiped from the record, though there are hints of a highly-televised and tragic sports-related incident, and association with a terrorist group
- Keith was kidnapped as a candidate of the "Farseer Project", joint project between DHK and 100G to create Psycho Powered super-soldiers
- Escaped the lab and found life in North Rock under the care of Marcus Almasi and Maya Smith through the Rogue Reactor
- Gained notoriety "The Stray", a Temp found aimlessly wandering the streets and getting into brawls with various gangs throughout Haven, mostly North Rock (Akuma, Bolters, etc)
- Recently infected with Demonic Qi during a battle against a Corrupted Cultivator, but was able to manifest the Qi, albeit roughly, as his own
- Overcame trial against his Demonic Qi, gaining control over it and purified of the experimentation's effects

Physical Description: Kelden is a taller man, knocking about 180cm/6'. He has long, white hair braided behind him, a single teal horn protruding from above his right ear. He's dressed in loose Tian Yin clothing and always has a determined expression on his face.
Story Summary:
Kelden grew up as the prodigy of a small Leytik village that believed in a philosophy of "Cycles". 
He was imprisoned for wanting to leave, and so was a snake spirit beast the village's elder had captured. The two, putting their strength together, escaped and hid in the mountains while Norbu taught Kelden cultivation, then started wandering and exacting change. Eventually they found themselves on the Worldhelm as they fell into a ravine where a Realmstorm saved them.

Physical Description: Khaal stands tall at 7'8 feet, with an athletic, muscular build. Tiger ears emerge from his head, complementing his slitted pupils, black stripes that run down his body, and lethal claws.
Story Summary: Born a half-Rakshasa, Khaal is the son of a Rakshasi woman and a father who relentlessly honed his mind and body. In the Tiger Lands, he walked the middle path between humanity and the bestial spirit. From his father, Khaal learned the importance of self-improvement, striving to be just a little better each day. His mother instilled in him a deep connection to the land and an unwavering courage. With these principles guiding him, Khaal faces the world, always ready to test his claws and be a steadfast ally and supporter. Now he travels to discover who he is apart from devotion to his home and its myriad conflicts.

Physical Description:
Standing at 5'9" with a fairly average build, Kit has tanned skin and hair that is dyed bright blue. His most notable feature is his right arm, coated in a layer of misshapen flesh which seems to shift and undulate when watched closely.

He wears a white overcoat while working, and carries a variety of supplies to provide medical treatment even in harsh environments.
Story Summary: An abandoned experiment from North Rock who was raised by a slum doctor. After the doctor's violent death, Kit continues to work as an itinerant doctor, treating those who cannot afford medical care.

Physical Description: Klyra is usually completely obscured by a massive dark purple cloak that reaches the floor, containing a plethora of archaic technology from The Old World, and a mask that covers her face. In this outfit she appears around 190cm but in actuality she's a shortstack who wears stilts and the intimidating garb to try and look more villainous. She's always accompanied by a pair of floating masks similar to the one she wears, one blue, the other a dull magenta.
Kohaku is a slender man, standing at 5'9" typically wearing formal garments - strangely immaculate and obsessively clean exterior though suitable for his vocal occupation.
Story Summary:
- Born from a fallen noble house as a consequence of the shattering.
- He became a negotiator of Murata that aided the mayor directly.
- Occasionally, he traveled to surrounding villages to ensure safe transport of food and other supplies from Murata. 
- He left when the first goldhearted returned.
- He later became the Senechal-in-Training on behalf of Teisei.

Physical Description: Koishi is a half-red oni girl in her late teens with two red horns protruding from her head, slightly covered by a huge mane of white hair. She stands tall at 6ft and lugs around a great pickaxe by her side.
Story Summary:
Born a half-red oni in the oni stronghold Ishiyama, she and her frail mother had to beg to survive. 
At the age of 6 Koishi's mother passed away, leaving her wracked with anguish.
The pain and anger of losing her mother, and the tyranny and poverty they all endure, solidify into Koishi's raison d'etre. 
Koishi continues to grow and train, biding time until unleashing a revolt against the oni masters and reclaiming the name granted by her mother.

Physical Description: Kawa is 4'11" with a thin frame and pale skin. With long, white hair that is typically stylized and well-kept. She is fairly expressive, wearing a smug smile in conversations with strangers. Typically wears a jacket, with a tank top underneath, as well as pants, and boots. But likes to dress up often.
Story Summary:
- Their mother is Sayumi Sasaki, an executive in 100G Security.
- Was the highest scoring student in her school. Almost entered a prestigious college sponsored by Orrery until she declined.
- Became a TEMP with her twin sister, "Saki", using Sayumi's connections to get a license.
- Both of them briefly worked with the Goldfingers.
- Their main goal is to help gather funds for their younger sister, "Mina", to a good school and to look out for her.

Physical Description:
Kori is a relatively tall woman at 5'6. The best word to describe her would be: Well put together. Her brown hair is immaculately kept, her glasses are always clean. If she is not wearing her school uniform (always pressed), she is wearing a lovely, regal green dress (always immaculate). The closest to 'unkempt' one could argue for her is her freckles, which she never bothers to cover up with her make up.

Kori never wields a weapon, and the reason why becomes very clear as soon as conflict begins: She becomes a long, heavy spear. The spear has an impressively keen edge, and seems to truly come to life when battling truly impressive foes.
Story Summary:
* Born fifth generation of an old family. 
* Her parents expected her to follow the family tradition of enrolling as a Paladin. 
* She tried to help her brother get ready to also enroll, but her parents were awful to her about it.
* She passed the entrance exams well, but surprised (and angered) her parents by joining the House of Treasures.
* Sped run through getting to the rite of binding. Her father is angry and wants the rite removed from her, but even if it could be she wouldn’t.
* Father has been harassing her non stop. This has affected her ability to get good grades and socialize.
* To alleviate this, she is yeeted off to the remedial class.

Physical Description: 172 cm tall, paleish skin, blueish green eyes. slightly spiky brownish blonde hair, commonly wears a blue jacket and dark orange jeans, headphones and respirator
Rare Equipment: None yet
Story Summary:
A second generation racing prodigy from Terra, Kris was expected to carry on his parents legacy in the augmented reality racing leagues and potentially win the Grand Prix. During his school days he usually kept to himself, focusing on his studies mostly due to people picking on him for being "different".

On his 17th birthday, both his parents suffered bad crashes and  mysteriously disappeared forcing Kris to sell off most of his family's racing machines and tech in order to stay financially afloat, and even entered the league himself to find out what happened to his parents.

During one such race, he was struggling due to heavy resistance from the other racers, and was close to his racer breaking down. Instead of pulling in and retiring from the race, He found a fire within and contuined on, and on the final lap, a Realmstorm hit, just as he crossed the finish line, disapearing in a bright light, which was assumed to be a pyrotechnic stunt.

Physical Description: Standing at a rather imposing 8'5" before factoring in his horns, and weighing in at roughly 650 lbs, Kunzang is an absolute fucking unit, even for his people. This massive specimen sports a two-tone fur pattern of white and red, large horns that turn black as they go on, and traditional clothing of the Holy Harmony's practitioners.

Standing at 5'0 ft tall with Dirty blonde hair, wearing a white jacket and carrying a brown backpack, he carries a Standard Issue Rifle from the KPLA and also has a prosthetic arm due to him losing his original one on his operations to fight merrane.

Story Summary:
- Born in Korala with his Father and His mother.
- Mother went Missing.
- Kurso was taken out mid education to help with Full Metal Militia.
- Kurso Rebelled and Escaped his father after freeing a bunch of people that were being experimented on.
- Arrived and was forcibly signed up to the KPLA in Bastion.

Physical Description: A 5'4" human woman who only looks human to a non-human. She has purple eyes, and hair that's green on one side and white on the other. Her skin is a bark brown color. Her attire is a weird mix of Kor'Tarion and Lhodos, wearing a wide poncho with several completely unnecessary belts. For those well acquainted with Dhata, they seem like they could be cousins, aside from all the clearly inhuman influences.

The line that runs across their back is not coloration; it is a long row of teeth and fangs which open to a terrible tendril-filled maw that spans its entire body. To be polite, Kxax covers this unnatural form with nice ponchos and a pointy purple hat.

Story Summary:
A monster created in secret beneath Caer Moryd. He rejects the urges of his nature to do good and has a mostly-positive track record of doing so.

Since becoming a Goldhearted, he's pursued academia at Hudal Academy, cast his lot against the crown with the Truehart coalition, and dreams of establishing a place where folks like him - unusual but well-meaning - can find peace.

Physical Description:
A short and meek boy, Köll wanders the tundra of Aldistir. His pale skin and silver hair clash with the black of his eyes, revealing the Godblood within.

Altough he is a Yokai, his only bestial trait are his sharp claws and teeth. He wears a fur mantle to keep the cold away, and his hood is decorated with fluffy canine-like ears to be more easily recognized as a Yokai.

The slight smell of blood follows him around...
Story Summary:
- Lost his memories after being touched by Godblood.
- Koll is basically a draugr, with all that entails.

Physical Description: A tall, lizardlike humanoid standing at 6'2". Kezhari's purple scales are smooth to the touch, and she has floppy ears with a doglike muzzle to boot. She typically wears a long, flowing robe and hats of questionable fashion sense.

A slight vanara with poofy brown fur. He's just as tall as his sister, and dresses in clean reds and blacks. His firework cannon is always on his back, and if it leaves him, it always returns to him eventually.
Story Summary: Vanara raised with his twin sister in a solitary village in Xiaohai. The village revered them, but they wanted more and more personal relationships. So, they set their wanderlust at the helm and departed.

Physical Description: Standing at a glorious 5'6, with her head covered with short silver hair and a large pair of ears. Her golden eyes rarely stand still, always looking around. Over her feline tail is her bag tied to her waist that she carries around at all times.
Liam has shoulder length black hair and a short beard. He stands at roughly 6'4" and 280 with mass of muscle to accompany.

Standing at around 5'10" and wielding an oversized pair of scissors, Lilac appears intimidating, to say the least, despite her elegant dress sense and slender frame. She has long, white hair, purple eyes befitting of her name, and carries herself with poise and precision.

The strange scissors she carries everywhere is made of a pristine silver, inlaid with gems of varying purple shades.
Rare Equipment: Soulshearers

Physical Description: At 4'10" with massive furry brown ears and a pink tail, Liliwen looks mousy in more ways than one. Despite her stature, she is strong and built with the muscles to show it. Not that they're often visible, with the gilt steel plate she wears over deep green padding. Her hair is long and pale blonde, falling quite far down her back when not tied up neatly to fit in her helmet. Her eyes are ruby red, and when she opens her mouth one can notice slightly pronounced buck teeth.
Rare Equipment: Shining Plate: Runic Plate with Composure quality
Story Summary:
* From a common-born family with a history in and around Tradefair (and Honeydew before it). She was born in Tradefair.

* Her father had an encounter with a fae that left him changed, marked by the ears and tail of a mouse. He has not spoken of what happened or what fae he encountered to Liliwen. She inherited these features herself.

* Liliwen grew up a scrappy little rascal and matured into a scrappy little lady. She channeled her competitiveness into work as a mercenary with the Iron Anvils, and made a name for herself despite some misgivings and prejudice.

* In the middle of a job gone bad, Liliwen approached a Realmstorm and was whisked off to the Worldhelm. She has done heroics while also returning home often to do her job there.

Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Xuanwu City
Physical Description: A pale lady seemingly in appearance around her late twenties, with long white hair and a keen eye. Standing at 170cm in height, she carries herself with grace until she loses herself, in which case she becomes enthusiastic and eccentric to a degree.
Rare Equipment: Black Ice Pendant of Xuanwu (Heirloom, Dual Resistance Ice/Dark)
Story Summary:
* Older woman, once married. Husband died, child missing. Became a hoarder and isolated. Lives in Xuanwu City
* Was sent to the Blood Mines, almost froze to death. Lost her arm to hypothermia
* A Spirit Snake found her, saw her potential and fused with her, giving up it's own life to save hers.
* Taught Cultivation by the Intelligent and Powerful Spirit beasts to learn to control her new power.
* Returned to the City, reborn anew.
* After a while, returned the Power the Spirit Beasts had given her, for returning that power, she was gifted with new ones.

Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Jinjing Xiantiao, Bingchuan
Physical Description:
A tall and imposing man, this Jinshi warrior possesses a powerful, towering physique. His broad shoulders and well-defined muscles sculpted through years of battle and cultivation, his chest and arms are marked with scars, each a testament to past conflicts. A thick, wild mane of dark hair flows around his face, further emphasizing his guardian lion-like heritage. His clawed hands are large and calloused, built for both combat and protection. His legs are equally formidable, covered in patches of fur that lead down to powerful, clawed feet, giving him a beast-like stance.

He wears a flowing green robe adorned with subtle, intricate patterns, tied at the waist with a wide, crimson sash decorated with cloud motifs. A large fur pelt drapes over one shoulder, hinting at past victories over formidable beasts and spirits alike. Hanging from his waist are gourds and additional cloth ornaments, resembling ceremonial talismans and protective charms against corrupt cultivators.
Quirks: Hunted Emissary : Boon of Self Perfection
Story Summary:
- Born to a relatively respected family, Lin's life was marred with tragedy before he was even born.
- Lin struggled under the weight of expectations from his family and pedigree both. Having been born a Jinshi he was expected to achieve more.
- He struggled with fundamentals that others took to easily, however he had a strange connection to the wildlife around him.
- Having had enough, on his 17th summer he vowed to prove himself. After saying his goodbyes to none save his mother, he'd take his fathers Guandao and leave the village swearing to prove his worth.
- In the bamboo forests surrounding Bingchuan he'd find his prey. A spirit beast beset by corrupt cultivators. In the end he'd choose to aid the beast, giving it a chance to fight back.
- As a reward, the beast would instruct Lin. Imparting their knowledge that in turn would allow him his own breakthrough.
- Lin now prowls the forests with Xuhu a descendant of the spirit beast, hunting corrupt cultivators.

Physical Description:
About 6ft tall, Lionel Il'Hrarra is a fount of little guy energy. To combat his little man aura, he dresses up in a style reminiscent of sailors and their ships in Ripplith, always decorated in a coat and a set of boots, usually with some sort of net for an accessory.

It is a rare event to see him in normal clothing.
Story Summary:
- Born to a noble family in Ripplith, Lionel was the firstborn daughter, and the heir apparent, set to inherit the authority of the family.
- They come out as trans, and go to a Seamother to undergo the ritual to fit into a body of their own.
- Now a man, and unable to hold authority in the matriarchal society of the Galeo Empire, their family looks down on him for throwing away his birthright and responsibility.
- He is then sent off to the Gnosis Academy to find his own path, and so as to no longer be in his mother's sight.
- Lionel takes well to the classes and the trials of becoming a Regalia yet all the while there is a sense that something is wrong. He struggles to make friends and socialize, and after some months his grades begin to slip...
- Thus, he is in the remedial program.

Physical Description: Lizbern Harfell is an average sized young woman with short red hair and green eyes.  Her torso and arms bear burn scars from when she was young.  She typically wears dark cargo pants, a plain red shirt, and a long black leather coat regardless of the weather.  She wears fingerless gloves with a thermal device attacked to the back of them.  Her left arm bears a metal bracer with a control interface that she uses to call in her mech.
Story Summary:
-Born in Vale
-Lost parents in attack
-Brought to Ionian Village
-Joins KPLA as teenager
-Steals a mech from Merrane
-Brought to Worldhelm after nearly dying

Physical Description: 5’6 feet tall, 140 lbs. Looks somewhat scrawny, but is just rocking a sleeper build. Never seen without his helmet on and his weapons close by, even when relaxing and sleeping. The only thing you can make out through the helmet's visor are piercing blue eyes. Gives off an intimidating aura that very quickly melts away the moment he speaks.

Lochlann is a lion-augmented businessman flecked with white, gold-tipped fur who stands at an impressive 6’9”. Contouring his muscular frame is a kevlar-lined suit that protects him in the boardroom and the streets of Terra.

His gentlemanly demeanor and typically warm smile can quickly turn cold when his friends and colleagues are threatened. Along with a power watch capable of creating energy shields, an unusual black device affixed to his belt reveals his technical skill as a medical researcher.
Rare Equipment: C.A.T.S. (Heirloom) [Formulaic]
Story Summary:
- Created as an augmented clone of his father, Magnus, the necessarily ruthless CEO of Regenekhan Pharmaceuticals on Terra
- Befriended Caelan Blacklaw (another PC) at a high school in Haven, but has lost touch with him since then
- Worked as a mid-level manager at PARABELLUM's R&D
- Employed as head researcher of Regenekhan using his degrees in medicine and business
- Raised by Magnus to be second in line in the Carlisle family and supports his older brother and top executive, Alistair
- Seeking a change in life after the events of Skyfall and his disillusionment of Terra's corporate regime on everyday people
- Responded to a text from Caelan to meet up at a bar and ended up in Worldhelm
- Carries an heirloom device called C.A.T.S. (Chemically Adaptive Thermo-Synthesizer) that fabricates randomized compounds, but it’s a prototype that agents from other companies want to copy or steal

Physical Description:
162 cm (5'4") tall, young, effeminate-presenting person. They have short, dark brown hair and sharp violet eyes that shift between guarded and expressive. Clad in dark tactical gear under a white medic’s jacket, their outfit is accented by a red scarf, the standard Gnosis academy shield plate, and a gloves with grappling hook

Whilst at downtime he wears his Gnosis academy uniform, wearing a red scarf and an emblem of the House of Paladins.
Story Summary:
- Lyle was born in Heartdom to a family of Couriers and has a robot companion, Vial, from Steelbin, who loves exploring the Reflections of Lilith.  

- Vial met Lyle while Lyle was making deliveries and being chased by a monster. Lyle trapped the monster under debris, saving Vial.  

- A Warden, impressed by Lyle’s quick thinking, recommended that he enroll at Gnosis.  

- Lyle’s parents approved, though hesitantly, and he joined Gnosis after finishing his deliveries.  

- Vial, rebellious and independent, enrolled at Gnosis without their parent's knowledge.  

- After 3 years of studying, Lyle discovered his body couldn’t channel any magic.  

- He joined the Remedial class to uncover why and to support Vial, who sought distance from their family.

Physical Description: Lynne is a sturdily built woman, clad in a modified Gnosis Academy uniform. The bag at her side carries both her weapons of choice, a pair of oversized, cleaver-like daggers, as well as the requisite materials she needs for her studies of war and magic.
Story Summary:
- Born in Steelbin on Kaiway, Lynne-4 and her family were governmental intermediaries, in charge of management and logistics of resources in their area

- During a trip outside of a civilized zone, Lynne was separated from her group during an ambush, and was left to wander and fend for herself, until she was found by a paladin and their regalia, who recommended her to Gnosis Academy

- After three years of attendance, Lynne was consigned to the remedial class, and sent to the Worldhelm to grow stronger alongside the goldhearted and her fellow classmates

Physical Description: An old man who's appearance is hides his true age, Mabilis stands at 6'1 with an athletics build, bearded with a disheveled head of grey hair held up by a headband. He wears light clothing covered in a heavy cloak dyed a blue reminiscent of the ocean, a style recognized easily as that of a martial artist hailing from Tian Yin. His face is deep set with scars and wrinkles alike, but Mabilis often wears a smile despite the clear toll the life of a cultivator has taken.
Story Summary:
- Cultivator who trained in secret alongside two other students under a surviving master of the war against heaven, Ghatu Na'alon
- Fought against corrupt cultivators and spirit beasts in his youth during his training
- One of the other students turned to corrupt cultivation in the hopes of gaining power to change the world more quickly
- His master was slain by his fellow student, who was his best friend
- He and Alab, the grandfather of the yet-to-be-born Hiya Salamin, went on to chase down their traitorous friend for years.
- Upon finding them, they were both defeated, Mabilis survived only due to their past friendship, while Alab died refusing to accept mercy.
- With a broken cultivation base, Mabilis spent a long time recovering, eventually finding Gan-Gan at the base of Mt. Magayon and learning to once again cultivate from the old spirit beast
- He would later come to become a local healer, and eventually mentor Panlinggo Umaga as an older master who might provide some guidance.

Physical Description: Mae is a young woman who stands at 5'8". She normally wears a bit of an angry expression when she is in thought or not actually speaking, which things then quickly change to a smile and she gives off a more upbeat energy. She skin is pale and her eyes read giving clear signs of insolvency to those who are familiar with it. Her normal attire would be a bit punkish in style.
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in Babyl City in Dawnstar Valley.
- Raised by a single father who worked in one of the manufacturing plants ran by Tubal & Cain
- Proved to accel academically and skipped a grade during school where she befriended Alec Lyon, who was a grade below her.
- Preferring to do engineering work Mae had an aptitude for working with explosives and eventually started doing work for T&C
- Moved in with Alec to help keep bills easier to manage, and shared an apartment. The two eventually formed a romantic relationship.
- Does Temp work to give field demonstrations of T&C explosives.
- About a year ago while working with an experimental explosive in her lab, something went wrong leading to an explosion that claimed Mae's life, but due to debt from research this lead to her being brought back as an insolvent.
- Using her unique explosives she was able to help clear and break down many of the rocks the fell during the Skyfall, leading to her being taken by the ship as a Goldhearted.

When Mafqud inherited an artifact from his Grandpa, a cabinet he found inside the ruins, Mafqud had to flee, as this cabinet was magical and he didnt want to be branded. 

The Cabinet attracts things people lose and other random trinkets - a side business of his family Mafqud never thought too much about before he knew where they were coming from. 

He fled, posing as travelling peddler to avoid persecution but still was almost caught - receiving the call saved him.

- An extreme busy body that handles two jobs: An SWORD Employee who handles the backend of Triworld and makes sure the androids work properly and a field investigator for her uncle's exorcism shop.

Mei-Mei is the twin sister of Lei-Lei. She grew up with him under a cool old man she calls "Gong-Gong." He taught her how to fish, how to fight, and most importantly, how to play mahjong. She vows to be able to beat him in a game one day, and to do so (but also cause she was bored) she leaves to go on an adventure with her brother. After making one funny chaos formation, they end up in some trouble.

Physical Description:
Mel stands at a moderate height, around 1,75 cm. A dense high ponytail, woven with an intricate braid, showcases her striking yellowish orange hair, resembling that of a lion. Her brown eyes bear sparkling traces of yellow, showing to the future a bright view with optimism. 

She dresses in hot and sunny colors, which complement the looks of her hair and the little but furry tail on her back. Those colors exhibit her liveliness and her bright, positive view in life.

Melinda is a slim, tall and sharply dressed female human from Terra. Her white hair is often arranged in a high ponytail with little hair streaks by the side, hiding the handles of her round reading glasses she sometimes puts to good use.

Her style is often high class, after already having seen the lows of life, usually sporting a black tie as a habit from her monster hunting days at Parabellum. Her go to colors are white and black, matching her hair and overall personality.

A smile for the welcome, a fist for the wicked. This is the philosophy that has carried her for the last few decades, and will continue to until her last breath.

- Milo was born in Hedgeberg to a small family. Aravik and Yvette Fleiss. He was the eldest, with a sister eight years younger than him named Reeve.
- When Milo was 16, his father left to Bastion to work on the ramping production of his design for the Undercity. Aravik was a member of the KPLA, working alongside Angelo Letterman as their earliest chief engineers.
- During that first year, a strike meant to kill both Letterman and Aravik Fleiss, executed Milo's father. In the wake of this, Milo become the man of his house.

Story Summary:
- Born from the head of the Clear River Sect Mo Tengfei and his concubine Wu Liling, both of which loved their child dearly.
- Mo Tengfei's wife, Mo Meilin, is disgusted with Jun-Hie's existance.
- He entered his father's sect and studied Ink Cultivation under him. Eventually, Jun-Hie started to take his Cultivation down his path, Focusing on Painting instead of just calligraphy.
- The Clear River Sect used to be a minor sect that focused on archival duties and information gathering. The cultivation they taught was Ink cultivation. They did not partake in corrupt cultivation since it crossed one of their virtues.
- One night, Mo Tengfei betrayed his own sect. Jun-Hie was the only one left alive.
- Jun-Hie spends his time trying to improve his own craft while searching for information on his father.

They're typically shy and say little, and can move very quietly.

Panlinggo is a very tiny mountain, standing to a straight 4'9" high. His almond shaped eyes are deep as volcanic smog, and bare an ember of red sparks within. He has soft, round features, a pudgy, short nose, and big, circular ears. His earthy, tan skin is speckled all over with dusty freckles, and scuffs from burns and bare body strikes. A fluffy mop of deep brown bounces on his skull, the longest of it tied in a ponytail behind them and in two short tufts of blond at the front.

Pan wears a loose, patterned, bright red poncho overtop a snug, black shirt cut at the midriff and elbows, and high at the neck. Two wide, gold bracers cuff at their wrists, and a drape of gold lanyards hang from his neck. Around his waist he wears two sashes, red and sky blue, tied and draped to cover the back and front of their lower half. Loose black shorts end with similar patterns to their poncho, and gold bands wreath their ankles.
Story Summary:
All Panlinggo can know is that he was born under auspicious circumstances, which left his mother chronically ill, and his father missing. Panlinggo and her stayed further out from Pagapalay, the villagers worried they would grow sick, or cursed, leaving the boy alone to take care of her when he came of capable age. Despite occasional visits from the master Mabilis, and medicinal care from well-meaning village shamans, the mother's illness would not cede. So when Mt. Magayon rumbled with dire warnings, the choice was made clear.

Poor Panlinggo could not handle the pain, and sought Mabilis for aid. He begged the old master to teach him Cultivation, but Panlinggo's Qi seemed seized, locked somehow. In desperation Panlinggo climbed to the top of Mt. Magayon, and threw himself into it's belching maw. Nobody had seen Panlinggo for quite some time since, but he has found himself in the worldhelm, the rage of the mountains swelling inside him.

Physical Description: Before you stands a monolithic man, clearing well at and past seven foot when standing with a width to him that matches such heights. His appearance from head to toe gives off the appearance more befitting a monster than a man. Deep scars along his body and face, heavy furred body, piercing yellow eyes, and large teeth visible when he smiles or speaks. Despite resembling a hyena like monster, Perseus comes off as either focused but more often jovial and good natured. He makes himself the biggest man in the room simply by being in it, be it by standing grand or being bigger than life in presence alone. His attire ranges from the blue Gnosis Academy uniform and Paladin Crest, to the dark black armor along with crimson cape resembling the style of Dreadlan. Always around his neck is a collar resembling the face of a fox. If he is seen carrying a weapon it is more often than not his Regalia 'The Overture', an oversized and unruly yet regal Gunblade.

- Born from Dreadlan Paladin Argos and Dreadlan Witch Aegea.
- Raised to serve Queen of Beasts Akala as a knight.
- At the age of 16 was sent to Gnosis Academy to grow his combat talents and be educated.
- Met Apollo, a fellow Paladin in training who was struggling in school.
- Apollo instead became a Treasure, deciding to become Perseus' Regalia so both their dreams could come true.
- Perseus now aspires to be one of the best Paladins to ever live, and rise to a similar if not same position as Akala for his people's benefit.

Her brown fur, which is kept manageably trimmed at all times, is often speckled with simple braids and beads made from shells, rocks, and leather, complimenting the strange ensemble of items that dangle from her robes, causing a light clinking noise whenever she approaches. Apart from her various baubles and curios, she has precious little in the way of other possessions, aside from the large staff she uses to walk, and a large knapsack by her side, always empty.
Story Summary:
Ritveja was born to a collective of void monks in Leytik, and was taught techniques on how to cultivate her own special kind of void Qi by intaking new experiences, and meditating on them to flush the ones she could not learn from out of her mind and body

When she came of age, she left the monk's compound, in search of ways to learn about the world, and apply her teachings to make it a better place. She began setting up a fledgling trade network between settlements in Leytik, trading things like beads, furs, clean water, and nonperishable food in exchange for their unwanted items, so that she could determine what things were good and bad for society, and more precisely flush out that which caused harm.

Eventually, her altruism and charity led her into a Realmstorm, which she almost cluelessly wandered into, ending up on the Worldhelm

Physical Description: Ronan stands tall at 6'2", his imposing presence enhanced by a cloak of dark fur draped over his shoulders. His skin carries a rich, sun-worn tone, complemented by dark brown hair that falls in unkempt waves. A single piercing sky blue eye peers out from beneath his brow, the other concealed beneath a weathered eyepatch. Beneath the cloak, he wears a black vest paired with rugged traveler’s garb, hinting at a life of constant motion. Rings of piercings adorn his ears, adding a touch of rebellious flair to his otherwise stoic appearance.
Quirks:
Hierloom:  Dread Tamer

The chains he wields are a manifestation of his Fae heritage, transforming what was once a simple Ashwynd Clan whip into a weapon infused with dark, otherworldly power. They serve as a devastating tool in combat, channeling the darkness within to annihilate those who revel in such forces. 

Drawbacks: The chains are unpredictable, reacting to his half-Fae blood at the most inopportune moments. Particularly when his heart races. Worse still, they are a glaring symbol of his dual identity, immediately marking him as both an Ashwynd and a half-blood, effectively painting a target on his back.
Story Summary:
Ronan Ashwynd was born into the storied Ashwynd Clan, renowned for their expertise in hunting demons and monsters. However, his heritage held a dangerous secret. His mother was a Fae, and his father kept this truth hidden for years. When Ronan was a teenager, the secret of his mixed blood was revealed, leading to his banishment from the clan. The betrayal cut deep, leaving Ronan with resentment toward the family that raised him yet rejected him for something beyond his control.

Forced to survive alone, Ronan embraced both his Ashwynd training and his Fae powers, using them as tools in his quest to carry on the clan's mission. Despite his dedication, his Fae abilities often mark him as an outsider, drawing mistrust from the human populace. Now, Ronan wanders Kor'Tarion as a lone hunter, grappling with the weight of his dual nature and the shadow of his past while carving his path forward as both a protector and an outcast.
