Physical Description:
Standing about 5’11, Selvaria has a rather refined yet somber appearance. Wearing a long radiantly snow white dress with black accents, an ornamental pendant on the left side of her chest, and a shoulder pauldron to protect her from any light attacks. Being blessed as one of the Oni in Aldistir, Selvaria has a pair of long black horns fixed on the top of her head. 

Having long pink hair with redish tips, Selvaria conducts herself with grace and care as her vibrant light red eyes look around the Worldhelm for anyone needing assistance with any particular task or matter. Yet even as she conducts herself normally in her new found environment, Selvaria occasionally shines brightly like a beacon - like a heavenly angel with loving etiquette to match.
Story Summary:
Not much is known about Selvaria besides the fact that she cared for those that resided in Camp Von Kibo as if they were her own children, helping the sick, the mournful, and the lost. Her history as being a prominent figure of tending to the wounds within the camp has led her to be known as a motherly woman, always willing to help others with grace even though she didn’t gain anything from doing so.

Even though her transfer to the Worldhelm was abrupt, Selvaria showed no sign of resentment towards her new surroundings but instead extended her own love and care to those around her once more - after all - even in the camp she tended to strangers, there was nothing different than tending to those who are deemed fit for this vessel. Though she often worries about those in the camp, hoping they’re alright - she hopes to visit them soon and aid them once more

Physical Description: Black, short-haired girl, red eyes, wearing a black dress with a small tie and a baggy overcoat. Cyan Magitechno markings strewn across her arms and clothes. She is 160 CM tall.

Standing about 5’7, Seraphina has a sleek yet foreboding appearance that could often be described as boyish. Wearing a white blouse with long sleeves and black accents, black trousers, and shin high steel tipped black boots. With long silky onyx black hair and crimson red eyes, her appearance leaves a striking impression with the addition of her pale white skin and the adornment of her pitch black draconic horns extruding from the top of her head.

Seraphina acts with suspicion yet expresses a friendly outgoing attitude, even on board the Worldhelm, she conducts herself with respect - one couldn't even know from a glance what her true emotions are underneath her protective facade. A part of her that she doesn't aim to reveal, not to no one but solitude itself.
Story Summary: A girl from Nezmira, looking for a way to become stronger ever since she was whisked away by the Worldhelm. While she lives in better conditions, she doesn’t completely trust those around her - a defensive mechanism that she unwilling developed during her time growing up in Nezmira.

Physical Description: Serena is a 5'3" girl with pink hair that is tied into pigtails. Out of costume, she dresses very plainly, a yellow blouse, brown skirt, and fake glasses to hide her identity. She walks with a hunch and is usually seen either frowning or a deadpan face. In costume, she wears a frilly, flowery, sparkling dress and carries a microphone. She always has a smile plastered on her face. Every now and then, wires can be seen running through the dress, connected to different speakers and mics in the costume.
Rare Equipment: Seri-Nya's Secret 🤫IV Kit

Origin: An unnamed village in the Albury Hills, Kor'Tarion
Physical Description: She is about 6'0" tall human woman. She has pale white skin, silver-white hair, and red eyes. She usually wears black outfits, dresses for non-adventuring and dress pants and suits for adventuring. She always wears long, thick leather gloves and she never takes them off. She also wears the same black boots for all her attire.

Shibana is a person born from a rosebush drenched in the blood of Ald and Yokai. Parts of their body are soft and light blueish green like a stem or leaf, others are coarse and grey like scar tissue. Brambles and purple roses wreathe their neck and form what might normally be hair. They wear clothes and armour, usually of Ald make.
Story Summary:
- During the War of Fox and Hound, a battle in the Feywyrd spilled a great deal of Ald and Yokai blood
- A certain rosebush thrived on the nourishment, but developed unusually...
- Shibana was born from this plant as a humanoid creature, having grown on and still retaining the memories, dreams and grudges of the warriors of the past
- They seek to broach peace between the modern Ald and Yokai, empathising with both sides' plights innately, while also dealing with their own internal dissonance
-  Camp von Kibo has been the main area to sympathise with Shibana's attempts, in particular an Ald named Blom has become Shibana's mentor

Physical Description: standing at around 6’3 with brown somewhat messy hair and a small beard wearing powered armor bearing the iconography of the KPLA

Shizuko is a humanoid Yokai. She has a mane of pale white hair which extends far passed her shoulders, seeming to operate under slightly less gravity than the rest of her form as it flits and floats behind her while she moves. From her top of her ear extend two vulpine ears, clad in the same white hair, which twitch often in response to noise, as if always on guard. Her adornment is mostly simple, remaining lightly armored, apart from a white mask which often covers her face almost entirely, shielding her eyes from the sun's reflection on the snow of her homeland.
Tsubasa is another vulpine Yokai, though her form is quadrupedal and much more bulky and athletic than Shizuko's. Her posture is similar to a typical canine, with rending claws and a thick mat of grey and white fur, though patches of incandescence give her the impression to sometimes be gleaming with a spectrum of light. Tsubasa is larger than most other fox Yokai, and is very capable of carrying another on her back.

Shizuru is a girl who is short in stature and has reddish gold straight long hair. She wears an eyepatch over her left eye, her right eye is emerald colored. She wears a military camouflage pattern scarf, and a maid outfit. While her face is beautiful, her emotions can be hard to read.
A boyish looking man of fair features and mid-length hair, he exudes an aura of scholarly wisdom...and mild trepidation.
Rare Equipment:
Cloak of the Crypt Keeper
The Bestiarium
Story Summary: A sage and scholar of the Blue City, he was raised to not fear the magic he was born with...turning to brush, spell, and page to defend him and the discoveries he makes upon the world.

Physical Description:
Simone is a 6'4" Nezzim with Crimson colored scales, fiery orange eyes, and curved horns. She can normally be seen wearing either her Cobalt colored armor or her black and blue captains vestments. She carries herself a level of rigidness almost akin to a model soldier. The biggest oddity to her looks is the two large wings on her back, something that is not at all typical for Nezzim.
Her choice of armaments is usually a spear or some kind of polearm, supplemented with a round shield for protection.
Rare Equipment:
- Ashen Pendant of Draconic Will
- Winged Spear of Force
Story Summary:
- She has a family, and they run a butchery in the city of scales.
- A Veteran General took Simone under their wing so she wouldn't fail her military training.
- Any military personnel from her career.
- Due to Simones job as a Captain within the military, She has a lot of experience in dealing with Kiir, and has also led multiple allies to their death in the name of protecting Nezmira.
- Owns a small plot of land as part of her Military Accolades, Has an estate in the City of Scales with branded of her own working there to maintain it.
- Simone has Blood Kiir stuff in her body due to forced experimentation upon her by Theoris (Why we have wings) and more recently she obtained Fire Kiir mana.
- Used to be a supporter of Theoris due to ignorance and Naivety, now hates him with a burning passion.

Physical Description:
Galahad stands at around 6'2, built like a young man who's profession before being a knight was that of a farmer. Broad shouldered and more heavyset than thin. More than often he is adorned in heavy armor with a heavy axe strapped to his back. A bed of well groomed blond hair and green eyes, greeting the world with an everlasting smile.

Lancelot is a griffon mixed with both a Peregrine Falcon & a Cheetah. Where many griffon's are built big, Lancelot is on the smaller side being younger, roughly the size of a big dog currently. She tends to have a annoyed expression, as if in a moment's notice she's going to get up to something that isn't good. Regalia that would normally be put on a knight's mount adorns her body, save for a saddle.
Story Summary:
- Farmer boy from Midholde
- Decided to become a knight to do more for his folks/people
- Survived the Bloodmoon attack on Midholde through - Fey intervention by being shunted through the woods out of there, one that has a pact/deal with older members of his family to "protect the family & farm"
- Moved to Brightshield and joined the experimental air force
- Was given Lancelot to train due to his affinity with plants/animals.
- Is now aspiring to try and be a beacon of light for others to makeup for his failings/shortcomings in not aiding in the Bloodmoon

Physical Description: A slender and light woman wearing a mask representing that of a skull mask made from fools gold, dressed in nun garb. She holds a crossbow to her side, and a religious symbol that for anyone familiar, resembles that of lilith. when she walks, it's almost as though she is barely touching the ground with each step
Story Summary:
Did something Horrendous in the Fey Realm and was forever banned from it, living in the mortal realm for Hundreds of years
Through trials and Tribulations, She found Lady Lilith, providing her the opportunity to shed her previous skin to adopt a new form
She now is a devout follower of Lady Lilith and will do everything in her power to spread the word of her lady

Physical Description: The once Blue-Scaled Nezzim now bears dark black scales, the occasional glint of purple and blue hues along them. A change in her very magical nature altering her physical form, showing the severing of her magic from the Dragonlords of Nezmira. Standing taller than most women due to her draconic nature, her stature denotes her as a scholar of the Arcane. She now bears the clothes of a wizard or witch, the styling that of Kor'Tarion of all places as if she found a fascination with their style. Even the looks of her magic altered and strange, now taking on dazzling colors and an otherworldly nature to it.
Rare Equipment:
Staff of Scholar's Past - Researcher
Prayer Bead Necklace [1000z Bound Accessory] - Ritual Up
Story Summary:
- Born a Pureblooded Blue Nezzim noble, mother was an archaeologist & father handled politics.
- They died during an investigation of a temple being overrun by Kiir.
- Growing up she made friends with a vagabond human, two became very close, and at 18 she got pregnant.
- Had the child in secret by living in another village in the desert for a year.
- Upon having the Ophidiyan, she left him with her spouse Micah and they went into hiding. Sloan knowing nothing about their situation.
- This spurs her on to help Branded and the Rebellion in secret under the alias "Azure Dream, keeping her cover as Theoris' right hand woman.
- At age 30, she watched Theoris send his son to become a Branded exile, this act cementing in her mind Theoris must die for a better Nezmira.
- Was a capable magician, until she had her abilities purged by the hands of Loftur.
- Her last spell binded and shackled the Angel of the End, saving many lives during the final confrontation.

Physical Description: A tall, slender man with long, wispy white hair cascading down his back, adorned with intricate runic tattoos etched along his limbs. Delicate wings made of faint rays of light extend from his shoulders, shimmering softly with every movement.
Slightly tan with a white, gold, and blue color scheme. Around 5' 11 in height, with some features of his non-human parent showing (such as his horns, tail, and patches of scales on his skin)
5'8" lithe build, armor focused around the waist down. Big metallic slab of steel strapped to back and ornamental jewelry. Too many bandanas. Just. Good lordy. Why do he have so many bandanas?!?!

Looks like a hot Twunk and an asshole. Exudes an either intense or mild aura of heat where ever he is(So it sucks if they have thermal vision). has too many belts, more armor along the legs than the top, and a massive slab of some mysterious metal with a handle as his blade.

A young man of middling height, Solomon Winter nonetheless stands out from a crowd. His hair is blond and tied back, his eyes a soft brown. His attire is an odd mix of a traveller's garb and finery. He carries himself with an air of nobility that belies his inner insecurities.
Rare Equipment: Fairy Dragon's Hair Pin (Accessory)

Character Sheet Link: [They told her to shrink. So she bloomed into a thousand beautiful suns.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1B4BSXbpT17ESXtwqcKbFmCIpWYlgHg6OISQVzyqP_t4/edit)
Physical Description: Standing at a statuesque 5'9", Solána possesses a captivating contrast between her rich, dark skin complexion and freckles that adorn her nose, shoulders, and chest. Warm hues of amber, gold, and crimson swirl together in her eyes, closely resembling Nezmira’s luminous sunsets. She often wears large golden earrings, alongside a silver bottom-lip ring piercing.
Rare Equipment:
Healer’s Call (Memorize)
Scales of the Twin Currents (Resist: Light, Dark, Poison)
Story Summary:
- Grew up in Windhaven with her twin brother and grandfather 
- Grandfather prophesied about the Blue City; together, they immigrated there for a better quality of life. 
- Started out as a battlefield medic; later became the revolutionaries’ top emissary/advisor.
- Discovered an Al-Shīfa shrine in the Blue City. Night of clarity later, she felt spiritist magic awaken within her.

Physical Description: Grey and brown mismatched eyes with and long black hair put in a ponytail, braids partially decorating the hair. A bulky build with several prayer beads and the like wrapped around his wrists. Silk, Furs, and leather belts draped across his form.
Story Summary: What is more known about Sonam is the reputation of his father, a man who has a list of accomplishments that are rarely seen, including the fostering of a Dojo in the more distant lands of Leytik - Sansarko's Gasp. The dojo has since fallen in obscurity in recent years.  Sonam has been seen in various villages in those isolated islands, leaving as soon as he can, getting resources along the way though very occasionally he stops and gives his aid to the townsfolk.

Physical Description: Song-5 is a 5'5" Oozian-Nymph girl with optimism almost always on her face. Her arcane, fae-styled armor braces her pink-sunset plasmoid form in place. Her bright, blue eyes sparkle with a matching ever-smiling mouth. She projects her emotions with the four pastel slime extensions of herself that surround her, making expressions that one face would be limited to.
Rare Equipment:
- ACESSORY - Necklace of Two Parts (Fey Negotiation Necklace/The Wizard)
- ARMOR - (Chivalrous Plate)
- SHIELD - (Scarlet Shield)
- SHIELD - (Runic Shield)
Story Summary: Song-5 used to be a human, but she gave all that up willingly to fully become a fey. Now the self-proclaimed "Queen Fae of the Goldhearted Court," she's selflessly ready to give her heart to all creatures! Except demons. Those guys get converted into IKEA furniture.

Class List: 10 Merchant, 10 Symbol, 2 Florist, 10 Tinkerer, loremaster 2, darkblade 1
Physical Description:
5'7
She's lost weight and muscle since she was last seen on the worldhelm. Her complexion has lost color.
The tips of her hair are no longer dyed; visible grey hairs from stress.
Story Summary:
-One of the founders of Sparrow; took on personal debt to create the company.

-A realmstorm appeared during a treaty celebration and she woke up in Lhodos.

-Lived there for roughly 5 years before she came to the Worldhealm

-Since then became a business woman of all the realms; using similar but different company titles for each realm.

When she finally returned to Terra discovered:
-17 years had past instead of the 5 years she had experienced in Lhodos
-Her debt has GROWN; contract killers/collectors.
-Her parents inherited the debt became insolvents. (haven't talked to yet)
-Closest friend Darcy Pertovac is now an insolvent (Talking to again)
-How history remembers Stock: "Disappeared when Sparrow needed her most in the face of her Depts"
-Sparrow believes she died or gave up and left them. 

-Suffering from depression and alcoholism.

Physical Description: Nearly six feet tall (6'10" if you include the ears), Storm has dark skin that contrasts her silvery-white hair and ice blue eyes. She typically wears a sky blue coat fringed with white and her entire right arm, up to the shoulder, has been replaced with a metal prosthetic. (She always gives a different story when asked how it happened.)
Story Summary:
- Born without name to unknown parents, Storm only remembers the hardships of trying to survive on the streets with her sister. 
- Ex-sailor turned pirate, she quickly became a captain due to her charisma and ruthlessness.
- Made a small name for herself by stealing primarily from Merrane's wealthy and giving to the less fortunate.
- When the Merrane began their invasion, she was more than happy to accept the request for help from the KPLA.

Other Names: the last Stroke on the canvas
Physical Description: scrawny person (often presenting female) with blue-ish hair, violet eyes and a big (staff-like) brush in hands
Story Summary:
- originally part of a Fae group that tended to gathering dreams of mortals (which coalesced as dew on big webs)

- accidentally touched these dreams and realized how bleak/boring their existence was

- used the dream dew to have fun and was thrown out for it to not disturb the group any further

- landed in Kor'Tarion where they were found

- with their ability to 'paint' dreams into reality, Stroke was bought to see that they can use their time meaningfully and have fun

- they often speak in metaphors that are not easy to understand, as they relate to their time as dream tender which can be not easy to understand 

- they relish most experiences even when they're bad/painful etc. as they love this new existence

Other Names: Jade Beauty of Ishiyama, Dancer of Flowing Rivers, Student of the Sword of Teisei, Lady of House Aiuchi
Physical Description: Dark haired, pale skinned, blue eyed young woman in a dancer's attire.
Story Summary:
* Survivor of an Oni Attack near Ishiyama
* Learned to dance from mother
* Studied Cultivation from books and water
* When helping people move to a safer village, she tried to lure Oni's away. Succedded and then died, or so she thought! (Worldhelm)
* Wishes to liberate the people of Ishiyama
* Pursuing Purusa to realize her Goal

Physical Description: A tall, heavily dressed person. None of their skin is visible and they wear a scary mask.

Syl is about the size of a human teenager and looks similar, with pale skin and a humanoid body structure. However, what sets her apart from a human are her gossamer wings, which hang like a cloak from her back, as well as dainty antennae which twitch inquisitively atop her head. She is clad in robes that are seemingly made from the remnants of a silk cocoon, and clutches a curiously-shaped tree branch close to her at all times.

Sylvaine stands roughly at 5'10 without her heels on but stands closer to 6' with them. She holds herself to a level of prestige that many would make fun of. Her uniform is always well kept and the emblem of the House of Paladins always shown proudly on her shoulder. When she is without her Regalia she is usually unarmed, but in combat is seen wielding a machine gun known as The Hegemony.
Story Summary:
- Born to a family of graduates from Gnosis Academy. Expected great things of her but she often snuck out to try to show some form of rebellion against her parents.
- Met her friend and now bonded Regalia, Myeongjun Shin, during some of the outings. Becoming close friends with him during her childhood.
- Ended up enrolling into the Gnosis Academy after learning of the horrors of the other celestial spheres with Myeongjun.
- Now is the wielder of the Hegemony and training as a Paladin of Lilith.

Origin: Xuanwu City, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description:
A tall young woman at 5'8, Si Yu is a powerful woman. Her body is well muscled, and she wears clothes to show that off. Long brown hair hits the swell of her back, framing her body well.

Often on her right arm is a ludicrously large gauntlet motif'd with a dragon face. The gauntlet often catches fire, especially mid punch.
Story Summary:
Born in Xuanwu Village to the mastery of a Minor Sect known as the Jade Art Sect.

Born male, but her father had found a pill that he used to help her transition when she realized she was femme

Trained in Cultivation under her father, showed a knack for Body Cultivation and Heavenly Qi.

The Jade Art Sect held onto 5 magical artifacts. A Spear, A Gauntlet, a Sword, a Bow, and a Hammer

Coveted by the Black Fist Sect, the major sect attacked it and managed to steal four of the artifacts.

Si Yu was able to escape only by fleeing with the gauntlet. Her father sacrificed himself to let her escape.

Her life was saved by Dehua. She did not trust the girl at first, but eventually came to rely on her after she was healed.

After 5 months, she was finally fully healed and ready to enact her vengeance. And then a Realm Storm happened.

Physical Description: T.R.E.E stands at about 5'6", and is unnaturally dense and heavy due to their construction. Each footfall leaves a dissonant clang as they walk. Where cogs and scrap metal fail them, however, overgrown, seemingly magical flora keeps their form together, and assists in their movements, as vines lace in-between each joint. They carry around a simple binder of magitech cards, and are able to capture photos of whatever they are looking at, as upon closer inspection, the magitech lenses in their eye sockets appear to extend and retract, and change aperture.
Quirks: Arboreal. Weakness: Bolt. Status Immunity: Enraged.

Physical Description:
Taavi is a light-skinned man with shortish brown hair. He wears a rather wide-brimmed green hat, sometimes decorated with multicoloured flowers.
The coat he wears is rather old and shabby looking, yet it has pleasant look about it.
He carries a bag on his back that contains all the things he needs in life.
Story Summary:
- Human from the aldish Clan in Gravernmarq, left some years ago to learn more about cooking in other dwellings.

- Since he seldom returned to his birthplace, he often had a longing to belong to the places he studied at.

- So when a group of Wandering Merchants came along, all from different parts of the Realm he joined them. The call themselves "Catalysts of Commerce"

- While on a trip to Blood Pools to gather some bloody thistles for a dish, he was swept up in a Realmstorm and woke up in the Worldhelm

Physical Description:
Kiyo cuts a conspicuous figure at 6'4" (194 cm) tall and with one very large brown wing at her back, resembling a kite's (or hawk's), on her right-hand side. Her left side has none, a scar visible where it would have been let through her clothes. She has long dark hair which hangs straight, and inhuman golden eyes. Her feet are *quite* large and notably avian, yellow and scaly with three toes in front and one behind, ending in talons.

Her clothing is loose and flowing, ornate but generously layered. Beyond the practical needs of any clothing made on Aldistir, it was made to catch the eye and accentuate movement. Her sandals resemble tengu-geta but are interestingly shaped, given her feet.
Rare Equipment:
A collection of World Saver weapons, such as:

Windborne Nodachi: World Saver sword, 【Dex + Dex】+ 1; HR + 14 air damage
+2 Def, +2 M. Def, counts as a shield equipped for skills

Armor with Constitution: Immune to status effects when at full health.
Related Arcana:
Kuzunoha (She worships her)

Has bound Antikythera, Yubel, Banshee, and Cupid.
Story Summary:
* Born to a small semi-nomadic community of yokai, mostly tengu, kites blessed by Kuzunoha and their descendants.
* Grew up idolizing her older brother Masayuki and eventually joined him as one of the defenders of their community from Ald attacks and other dangers.
* In one battle they successfully repelled the attackers, only for Kiyo to find that her brother had fallen in the fighting. He died. In another battle, a raider slipped through and killed her unarmed cousin Hisa in the camp.
* Kiyo grew very jaded about all this violence that failed to protect her family, and was pained by thoughts of the family of all the people she had killed. She retreated to desperate idealistic belief that peaceful coexistence must be possible, a rejection that all this pain and death was the only way.
* Swept into a Realmstorm by reckless curiosity, she took well to having a purpose. She may also be running away from things. Just a little.

Physical Description: A 5'10ft man, cleanly shaven and cleanly cut hair. Edged proper to standards of a professonal working man. A Serious expression with sullen cheeks as a standard look, making it hard to tell wether or not they are upset about something, sad or otherwise from years of wearing the same look. Beautiful amber eyes dulled by a look of dispassion. While up there in age, maybe due to keeping fit or taking great care of his apperance, he does look maybe a few years younger than he actually is.
Story Summary:
- He has been working as an Employee of NTTech as a Office Worker for a some years.
- Recent years he has obtained a temp license from NTT for non-office space jobs.
- Doesn't have much contact with his son.
- Is unhappy with how things seem and feel around NTT as of current times.
- Was suddenly pulled in to the Worldhelm after intervening in a 100Gs operation and pacifying a monster situation.

Character Sheet Link: ["Time's on my side now. Sorry if you were hoping to use it against me. (I'm not)"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-4v1AIKI4ApbI94lQ_5WjPxZ46jNb25oWW6LmlE71hg/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: Tenzin is 5'7 (170cm) with a slight build. He has dark skin and now bright white eyes and hair. On the left side of his face is the bright blue scales that showcase a magic user.
Rare Equipment: No More Fear, Apotheotic Robes, No More Suffering, No More Masters
Story Summary: - Tenzin, now fully himself and connected to Antikythera, is a bit aimless, as he's now actually in the present and doesn't know what to do.

Physical Description: A short female human standing at 5'2 with short brown hair and green eyes. She is consistently found in her armor.
Rare Equipment:
Ring of Tales
Frost Shield
Scarlet Shield
Chains of Contrition.
Necklace of Two Parts
Story Summary:
- Born in the slums of Tradefair, taken in by a bandit king.
- Helped as bait for bandits for many years until she was 14.
- The bandit king was defeated by the Golden Claw Mercenaries and she was taken in after they paid for the bounty on her head.
- Spent many years redeeming herself and acting like a knight would.
- Became the squire of the Marshall of Brightshield.

Physical Description: Assistant is 7'8", weighing 319 lbs. They appear to be made wholly of rocks.
Rare Equipment:
**Craggy Coveralls** - Resistance to Bolt + Ice
**Lightning Rod** - +1 to Magic Checks
**Humming Bloom Shield** - Spells that target up to 3 creatures can target up to 4 instead
**Medic's Cloak** - Healing makes allies resist next instance of Physical

Not equipped:
**Antimagic Crystal Brooch** - Dispel can target up to 3 creatures
**Ugly Duckling's Golden Feather** - 1/Scene, after hitting Crisis, recover 20 HP.
Story Summary: See the bio

Physical Description: A small and seemingly fragile looking person, Due to his past he looks extremly effeminate and it would not be wrong to assume he be a woman. A fact he likes, simply because he likes womans fashion more than mens

6'2, pale skin, white hair, a thin tail, horns, one green eye one blue eye, pointy ears, it's outfit consists of a sleeveless shirt with basic armour plating over where his guts would be [y'know.... IF IT HAD ANY], as well as heavy duty black pants and combat boots.
Rare Equipment: nothing.

Class List:
Loremaster Lv. ★
Merchant Lv. 1
Tinkerer Lv. ★
Wayfarer Lv. 2
Physical Description:
This duo consists of a tiny pink engineer girl and a cat-size robot that's always either following her around, perched on her shoulders, or folded up into a briefcase somewhere on her person.

Tika's bag has downsized over time, but lots of technology is strewn about her person: a big capacitor on her hip, the butt of a bespoke rifle poking out of her pack, and all the tools somebody might need for impromptu invention.
Though it's usually hidden, a 3"×3" metal device is implanted in her, just to the left of the small of her back. It whirrs and glows gently at all times.
Story Summary:
Tika was an engineering prodigy in Merrane. She's one of the youngest ever to attend the Caldera Engineering Academy, where work for the crown is designed and constructed. When the conquest of Karlgard began, bright minds from Caldera were put to work to win the war, Tika among them. 

She didn't approve, but she kept quiet and put herself to work on infrastructural studies that could prompt a more peaceful joining of nations. When she presented her findings to the regent, she was dismissed for her dissent.

Physical Description: A slim and short human

Timothy stands a relatively small and scrawny 5'5ft wearing what can affectionately be described as the cyberpunk equivalent of clothes you would throw on in a hurry to get to to work, glasses and in a sort of retro touch carries a wrist mounted computer despite having access to more efficient cybernetics
Rare Equipment:
Get!Away Headset: the cost of soul network related rituals performed through navigator or cognitive ghost (if i had it) are halved
Daemonsbane Psirifle: Worldsaver Infantry rifle
Story Summary:
Timothy was born in North Rock, while growing up in the most dangerous areas of haven was tough at times, he could always find solace in games which would eventually lead him to wanting and eventually getting a job at SWORD

Freelance soulrunner who has previous connections to SWORD (hence the arcanum) who got bad intel on a job gone wrong and ended up getting sent through a realmstorm

Since becoming a goldhearted Timothy has aspirations of turning his soulrunner gig work into a proper company which he has been growing closer and closer to every day, he does however have a very difficult relationship with the Crimson Specters which could make this difficult

Physical Description: Tomiko is a 5'8" tall Half-Kitsune from Owaga, Teisei. She wears bright orange and blue clothing, and is never seen without her cooking equipment.
Rare Equipment:
An Old Chef's Cleaver (Dagger with Extra Seasoning quality)

Portable Spice Rack (Accessory with Improvisation quality)
Story Summary:
- Tomiko was born in Owaga, Teisei
- In her teens, she found her cooking equipment
- She was recently brought to the Worldhelm after having met other Goldhearted

Physical Description: Skinny 6 ft mute human male wearing a blue overcoat with a feather. Sporting a blond pompadour and carry around a wooden cello.
Rare Equipment: Queens Warmth (Quality: Loaded Dice)

Physical Description: A short 4'10 gal, often found in baggy clothing that hides most of their physique, often stained with dirt given her prior and current occupation.
Story Summary:
- Trif was born in The City of Nest and worked with her father at a young age to maintain the fields or the machines that do so. 
- She was raised on company values and often found herself attached to her plants that she had once she was young.
- She had made a name for herself, amongst others in various plant bioenginnering projects in Nest though never as the head researcher.
 - Occasionally, she helped fix up any accidents within the workplace, if someone got injured handling a machine and so on and so forth.

Physical Description: 6 foot tall human with blue and purple robes. Trinity is high energy and cheerful with a higher pitched voice.
Story Summary:
Trinity grew up in KorTarion as a magical human. He finally got accepted into Hudal Academy and was a student there for some time. His dream is to be a professor there and give magic to any creature who desires it, as he feels its a net benefit to society. 

One day while traveling to a beautiful lake he got caught up in a realmstorm and woke up next to a fountain...

Dul, a pumpkin person from KorTarion, introduced Trinity to the Ropes of the Worldhelm.

Physical Description: He wears a long read robe with blue pants, and black slippers. He has a pair of black, armless sunglasses. His hair is a blazing red hair an his ponytail moves like flames, pointing up and flickering and moving. On his for head is a Bindi and has pointed ears, signifying his half-yokai heritage.
White hair fox ears. Wearing a blue overcoat with a set of flowers on them. (White Anemone)
Story Summary:
- Early life he was raised by his kitsune parent who he does not have any memory of

- At 15 he was left to fend for himself near the outskirts of Hanae

- To survive, he uses the limited range of Inari's Will he has to find and heal both humans and kitsune injured from conflict

- Before getting on the ship Tsuiho made a vow of pacifism as the humans of Hanae are still weary of him and the kitsune treats him as a foolish child at best.

Physical Description: Tsutsuji is a large fox standing 4'2" at her shoulder with pale blue eyes and a pure white coat. However, when flowers begin to bloom across her body, the fur beneath turns an earthy black. She has three ribbon-like tails that float around her and branches that sprout from her head like antlers, flowers often growing upon them. All manner of flora may take root where she once stepped.
Story Summary:
Born from the very concept of a warming breeze and the hope of new life, Tsutsuji awoke in the Feywyrd four years ago on the first day of what would become known as spring.
With duty written in her bones, she raced through the forests, leaving a path of flowers in her wake and providing gardens of respite for the wounded allies of Kuzunoha and those fleeing the dangers of the Blood Grotto.
She was forced to flee her domain when an army of Draugr marched upon it, stumbling into a realmstorm before she could be surrounded.

Physical Description:
Tyra is an odd woman, standing at 5'8 with a build that ends up just on the chubbier side. Unlike before, she bares her arms and scars proudly, no longer will she be shamed for her past, not her present. She is covered in Aldistiri runes and tattoos, and scars from battle and blood sacrifice. Her cheek is marked with the brand of the archdemon Sanctimony, and her hair is tinged with gold and an otherworldly teal.

Her 'son', Utsuki Halfborn, is a hulk of a man, some eight feet tall with dark hair and fair skin. His flesh is marked across with stitches, and even though he doesn't talk much, there is a doubtless innocence in his eyes.
Related Arcana:
Cupid (Bound)
Yubel (Bound)
Vanagandr (Bound)
Qilin (Bound)
Kuzunoha (Half Yokai)
Story Summary:
Apart from her parents, Tyra spent all her life in Aldistir being rejected and shunned for her half-blooded nature. Once they passed, she was left alone... just her and the snow. And so she wandered. She wandered until she found company in a fellow outcast, an old witch by the name of Olga, who taught her the blackened art of necromancy.

After some time, Tyra put theory to practice, and put life to the lifeless. With her talents, and some months of work, she created the being who would be her son. Though he seemed monstrous on the outside, she loved him with all her heart.

Recently, after an extended stay with the demon Sanctimony and their cult, Tyra has found a measure of confidence. Should the world shun her for her being, then let them do so. But never will she hide herself again.

Physical Description: A tall red haired woman with pointed wolf ears on the top of her head that seem to constantly be shifting towards the nearest sound. Her long mane of red hair is scruffy and full of split ends that seem to curl upwards. Her figure is on the more muscular side with thick arms and legs that are usually covered by the dark tunic and pants that she is wearing.
Story Summary: Former Vanagandr cursed of Kor’tarion that broke her curse and now hunts the wolf wherever she can.

Physical Description: White hair novice looking male guard wearing outdated armor with a sword and shield.
Rare Equipment:
Chivalrous Plate
Travel Toboggan
Lucky Wristbands
Story Summary:
- Born and raised in Ironholde

- At 18 was a full time guard and was aspiring to become a Brightshield Knight

- Valen's Father Tadem Bell, died covering one of Valen's guard shift

- In his grief, Valen joined the rising Atee religion

- Valen left his town to go a pilgramage to find a way to redeem himself when seeing his father's death as his fault in his eyes.

- Thanks to a heart to heart talk with Zopheil, Valen reafirms his own will to live and enjoy life

Physical Description: Valentin is a 6'4'' tall augmented human, likening the appearance of an anthropomorphic tiger. His fur has an orange/cream tone. Usually he is clad in a tidy and expensive-looking suit, as well as a few distinct adornment, such as his gold necklace that holds a beautiful amber gemstone in it. Valentin's posture is quite proper and polished, adding to a perhaps imposing impression at first sight.
Story Summary:
Valentin was raised in a laboratory, subjected to genetic experiments and cybernetic enhancements before escaping due to a series of strange coincidences.
He spent years surviving on the streets, developing a deep hatred for technology and constantly fighting to stay alive.
After a desperate chase, he stumbled upon a medieval-style estate, where the head butler, Archibald Bernstein, took him in and trained him in the ways of servitude and discipline.
Valentin thrived under Archibald’s guidance until a technologically advanced force attacked the estate, leading to Archibald’s death.
Not long after, Valentin was chosen as a Goldhearted, and is now joining the Worldhelm

Physical Description: A middleaged woman standing at 5'7" with long silvering hair and gray eyes, a beauty mark beneath her right eye. Typically dressed in a well kept uniform she carries herself with and air of discipline and confidence.
Story Summary:
- Was a career solider in the People's Guard with Merrane.
- Started to develop an unknown illness that caused internal bleeding when her body is strained or stressed.
- Retired from field work at a young age and became a military instructor.
- Was stationed in Suntower to work with troops there.
- Hearing rumors of Suntower seceding from Merrane resolved to stand with Suntower as its been her home for over a decade.
- Begins trying to resharpen combat skills picking up magi-crystals to make up for lack of physicality she once had.
- Started to work harder to keep soldiers in Suntower ready and prepared in the event of retaliation from Merrane due to the rumors or in the event Suntower fully secedes.

Origin: Forgotten Shrine of the Fallen God, Aldistir
Physical Description: A little shorter than average at 5'8", Vanigad carries himself tall and proud. He has short blonde hair and tends to wear comfortable and well-worn gear suitable for his frozen homeland, though he likes to keep a set of nicer clothing for walking about, and he wears an eyepatch over one eye. His irises seem to shift in the light, so the color is difficult to pin down, but he always has a smile on his face, as if he knows a secret no one else could ever guess.
Related Arcana:
Vanagandr (previously followed)
Lilith (previously followed after leaving family)
Antikythera ("sole follower")
Story Summary:
- A blizzard blasted across the edge of the world.
- A lone Lilith follower sought shelter, finding what seemed to be a long abandoned shrine to the Fallen God.
- The Lilith follower, in return for using the shrine to outlast the blizzard, rejected his previous life and name.
- He gained power from the Fallen God, but in doing so put an expiration date on himself.
- He also gained a new name: Vanigad.

Physical Description: Vanille is a somewhat petite woman, who would only be about 5'2" if she could stand. She has no use of her legs and so is always found in a wheelchair, either a ruggedized one for adventuring or a more basic one for more domestic affairs. Despite her disability, however, she maintains a strong physique, displaying lean muscles in her arms and upper body, though these are usually covered by her modest clothing.
Story Summary: See bio.

Physical Description:
Ven is 6'0", weighing 136 lbs. They seem to be frequently tired, though they frequently look around to gauge their surroundings.

Vid is a small, dark sphere with a single yellow light in the center. It seldom leaves Ven's side, floating around them and acting as their form of speech.
Quirks:
Idyllic Soul
Technically dead, doesn't deal well with loud sounds.
Story Summary:
* The result of two great warriors - a demon named Cogitav, and an Empty Monk named Ergo Nonsum - clashing, with Ergo turning Cogitav's soul-rending against it.
* Both of their souls, and all of the collected souls within Cogitav, merged and mixed in a massive maelstrom as it went to Idyll.
* After a century of struggling to take form and passively absorbing souls surround it, the mass eventually congealed into the forms of Ven and Vid.
* This new gestalt soul has only lingering memories of who - and what - it was before this incident. It also hardly has knowledge of what it is to even be alive.
* Held together by force of will and curiosity, this new pair of bodies wanders to find out what life is about, and what its own unlife is for.

Physical Description: 5' 10" with a split aesthetic the white and gold representing the "good" side of justice such as returning stolen goods to their original owner, but the red and black side to represent the "dark" side of justice such as carrying out a death sentence for a known killer. with more loose or comfortable clothing his movements are relatively unrestricted

Verge is a tall, dark-haired humanoid with pale skin and red eyes.  Her limbs and a portion of her face and torso are covered in dark purple scales.  Her hands and feet end in sharp black claws.  Her most obvious feature is a massive second set of limbs that grow from her back which she can morph into different appendages.  She wears a sleeveless bodysuit under a black trenchcoat.  Verge has a calm and unintentionally menacing demeanor.
Quirks:
Fugitive Experiment
When a rule or ability requires you to spend 100 or fewer Hit Points, Mind Points, or
Inventory Points, you may suffer 1d8 Instability Points to ignore that cost.
At the end of each session (approximately four hours of play), you lose 1d6 Instability
Points (to a minimum of zero).
If your Instability Points ever reach 10 or more, you are immediately reduced to 0 Hit
Points and must Surrender. The consequences of this Surrender should be closely tied
to you losing control of your abilities. Then, you lose all Instability Points.
Story Summary:
-Created in a lab
-sold to T&C
-tortured and experimented on
-escapes to worldhelm
-On mission, learns she has a sister
-recaptured but her and her sister are rescued

Height: 5'7"

A woman of average build usually sporting a collared shirt and bracers attached to well worn pants tucked into boots.
Story Summary: Grew up and orphan, spends most of her time on expeditions and fought in the rebellion.

Physical Description: Vigo is 5'10", with black hair and blue eyes. She has a slim frame, but that misleads from the years of built muscle. Often times she can be found wearing her military uniform (as pictured in her art), and carrying her sword.

Character Sheet Link: [We're all skilled in different ways, focus on your strengths and you'll do fine. Welcome to the Worldhelm.](<https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10ksh65o-Y1Vir5y39xp3Dj0ZFXsJIuKsyyBHbpHgD8o/edit?usp=sharing>)
Physical Description: Vik has a medium build but broader frame at 6'2 (short for an Ald) and has slightly messy long white hair. They generally travel light with a flowy outfit to show off their multitude of tattoos spanning his body. His smile is usually noticeably small but his eyes are approving, offering his support with a stern face. This merchant sports a heavy crossbow across their back with faint orange runes carved into it and always walks with the sound of clinking potions in their bag.
Quirks:
Heirloom -- Scorch the Crossbow
- Side effects include overheating, dizziness, muscle weakness, fainting, and an occasional firey explosion
Rare Equipment:
Scorch (a multi[2], +1, fire crossbow)
Aegis Gorgonis (poison resist)
Story Summary:
- Grew up living as a tattoo (symbolism) artist in Aldistir that helped hunt Draugr
- Marksman father gifted him a magic crossbow he stole from a mage
- Father died after the mage found him and depressed Vik storms off to the Worldhelm
- Used to rely on symbols, but now uses potions in combat ever since learning how much he lacks in training
  - Support/Healer to give others the strength he doesn't have

Physical Description: Standing at 5'10" with a slender, serpentine frame, she has a body adorned with smooth white and peach-colored scales, accented by aquamarine markings along her ribs and tail. Her eyes are a striking rose-red, and she has Ruby Red horns. She typically wears light armor in shades of white and gold, leaving her midriff exposed for a balanced blend of elegance and agility.

Violet/Carmelita stands at 5'7", with striking white hair streaked with purple. She wears a sleek violet jacket over a black crop top, paired with white shorts and symmetrical stockings with sky-blue accents. Her white boots complete the sharp look.

Always ready for action, Violet carries two pistols holstered at her sides. Her stylish appearance blends cold professionalism with deadly efficiency.
Story Summary:
- Carmelita Aneta, codenamed Violet, was adopted by elite assassins after her parents' death and raised by a brutal mentor named Yori.

- Trained to suppress her emotions and become a ruthless killer, Violet harbored resentment toward her mentor.

- She seized the opportunity to betray Yori when a - group of Vignettes was tasked with eliminating her, killing Yori with a single shot.

- Violet was taken in by another Vignette member, who taught her hacking skills in addition to her combat training.

- After connecting with 100G officers, she became a Vignette assassin, eventually rising to become the right-hand woman of a 100G higher-up.

Class List: Ace of Cards ★, Elementalist ★, Entropist 7, Chimerist 1
Physical Description: Vista is 5'3", weighing 159 lbs, dressed to the sevens. It's like being dressed to the nines, but not *that* fancy.
Rare Equipment:
Moonlight Card Sleeves - Offensive spells **slow** the target.
Glitter and Gold - Spells that target a **slowed** enemy cost half as much.
Wavecrash Waistcoat - Damage dealt to **slowed** targets ignores Resistances.
Drained Spirits - When recovering MP, you recover 5 extra MP.
Story Summary:
* Was sired as a result of a deal with the Star-Eyed Stranger - one of those "give you great power in exchange for your firstborn" kind of deals. Upon taking the deal, Vista's human parent went "okay, so when do we start?"
* Grew up as an adoptee of a mob/mafia kind of deal. Used for her innate tychokinesis - manipulation of luck. Got herself out when she was young.
* Went to Tradesfair to be a dealer at a shady gambling den, with the intent of scamming rich fucks out of their money. Not many of those types show up at the place she worked at - she found she was just taking from those who didn't have much money to begin with.
* Leapt at the opportunity to do something better with herself.

Physical Description: Vivian stands at a shorter height of 5'6", a lean figure draped in lightweight hunting gear of mixed leather and cloth with a black mantle edged with black feathers over her shoulders. A feather pendant rests perpetually over her chest, tied with old leather. Pigment seems to be lost in a patch on the right side of her face and on other parts of her body, turning her right eye a smoky grey and interspersing her hair with locks of white with patches of skin a pallid white. Her unaffected eye is an inky black, and her hair is dark brown.
Rare Equipment:

Dark/Poison res, undead take 10 damage when they target Vivian.

*Quality: Dual Hunter (Undead/Demons)*

A gifted bow from the Yubel, hunter of great evils no matter what form they take.
*Quality: World Saver*
*Custom weapon - Elemental Weapon (Light), Powerful, Magic Defense Boost*
Story Summary: Born to the Ashblancs in Dryholde, Vivian lived her life happily betrothed to Ronan Ashwynd. Hunters of the night, trained, tempered, ready to fight alongside the Ashwynds against the monsters that would bring ruin to the pockets of humanity across Kor'tarion. All that was changed when Ronan was cast out, Vivian nearly killed by a Moonshard monster as she pursued him, and left infused with ice magic as she was taken home. Sent to Hudal academy to deal with this new curse, she went for years, only for her life to be upended once again at the blood moon. Surviving and fighting off demons, she returned home- only to find Dryholde shattered, house empty, and her family missing.

Physical Description:
Dark skin, black hair, golden eyes, and angular features, Waylen's looks apparently take after his mother. Standing at 6'1", athletic, and about 55kg, he physically takes after his father. Clothes tend to fit him well, if a little loose, though they never hang off of his frame. He tends to wear casual clothes, but he has some fancier outfits if he needs them.

With his Driver activated, Millenium wears a suit of purple tech-armor over black and dark blue synth-fabric, and a helm with wolf-ish angles and fiery electronics. The Driver itself has three coin slots, arranged diagonally from his right side down to his left.
Story Summary:
- Mother died before he could remember
- Father took care of him throughout his whole life
- After getting a job at a startup company, his father disappeared
- He searched for his father, to no avail
- However, that search made him realize that people were hurting, and turning to the gangs that only drag out their suffering
- He quit his job, stealing the prototype they had been working on
- He took up the mantle of Millenium to take on the gangs that make things worse, to help the people that need it, and eventually, to take on the corps that leave the gangs in charge

Physical Description:
A lithely built elf of average height, Web is often seen with a disinterest gaze on her face. Her violet eyes are often hidden under a snow white fringe, the rest of her long hair kept in a long single braid that reaches down to her waist.

Most of the time she can be seen wearing dark clothes, favouring blacks and dark purples or blues. While she wears different styles, she generally favours looser clothing, and universally abhors sleeves.
Story Summary:
- Born in the Winter Court of Kor'Tarion's Fae Realm
- Skilled with healing magic at a young age
- Promised to heal a sick person and failed
- For breaking her word, was exiled from the Winter Court.

- is here now :)

Origin: Shuanwu City, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description: A charismatic and young-looking cultivator. He is exceptionally well dressed in traditional Shuanwu City garbs, that elude to his connection with a cultivation sect within the city. He does not carry any weapons, always speaks softly, and with a big smile on his face.
Story Summary:
- Mother Changli, director of the Dawning Grace heavenly cultivation sect, prayed for a holy child.
- Jianghsi is born as a vessel for a reincarnation of Tianlong, Li Jing's (Seraph's) dragon.
- Mother taught him everything she knew.
- Corrupt cultivator from a different sect killed his mother to hold back the competition.
- Jianghsi loses most of the influence his family name held, and is humbled by force.
- Learns about the precarious conditions in Shuanwu City and takes it upon himself to make things better.
- Joins a small rebel group hidden inside the city walls.
- Get's shunted into the Worldhelm in the middle of a scouting operation.

Physical Description: 5'10", powerful, and a little intimidating with his facial scars, demon-aesthetic arms and armor, and constant glare, though some of his muscles are partially hidden beneath the yellows, greys, and browns of his second-hand robes. He has olive green eyes and long, dark hair he ties up, but a decent amount still falls in his eyes. Recent events have revealed the rage barely hidden within him.
Story Summary:
- Knew about his aptitude for demonic qi from an early age
- His qi aptitude cause him and his family to be shunned
- From a small village near the Stained Forests
- Family killed by a yokai one night, while he could do nothing but hide
- First cultivated demonic qi from the aftermath of his parents' murder
- Learned by feel, fumbling his way through cultivation
- Stalked Teisei, following behind the yokai and corrupt cultivators, cultivating from the aftermath of their battles and killings
- If he could, he tried to help people in trouble, but more often than not, he would only end up getting hurt or coming too late.

Physical Description: A woman with sun-kissed skin, her gaze is captivating. Light green horns emerge gracefully from her forehead, while two larger horns curve just past her temples. Her dark teal hair cascades around her, complementing the flowing attire of a traveling performer. Yet, it’s her eyes that demand attention. Expressive, enchanting, and filled with the allure of someone who knows the world is her stage.
Quirks:
BOON OF AUSPICIOUS WISDOM
You are one of the Bishi’e, a qilin-like people blessed by one of the sealed gods. You gain access to arcanist rituals of the knowledge domain. You also learn one spell from the elementalist, entropist, or spiritist lists. (Spell Chosen: Heal)

>When you take the Study action, your check triggers a critical success if both dice show the same number (and the Check is not a fumble).
Regardless of which boon you took, you also gain the following curse:

CURSE OF HEAVENLY ENMITY
When you Surrender and a villain is on the scene, they may choose to gain an Ultima Point instead of another Surrender consequence. This cannot take them above the maximum UP for their tier (for instance, this cannot bring a Minor villain above 5 Ultima Points). If this happens, all player characters in the game except you gain a fabula point.
Story Summary:
Raised in the **Jade Bloom Pavilion of Xuanwu City**, Yin Yue grew up in a sanctuary of music and culture, guided by her renowned mother, Yin Mei, who taught her to cultivate through song rather than rigid forms. As a Bishi’e, she possessed an innate talent for harmonizing with the Dao, shaping the elements and fortifying herself through melody.

Though sheltered within the **Pavilion’s Heavenly Blossom Theatre**, she could not ignore the corruption that tainted the city, where powerful sects practiced ruthless cultivation and mortals toiled in the blood mines. Yearning to restore harmony while forging her own legend, Yin Yue set out beyond her homeland, her voice not only a weapon but a promise. To bring balance back to a fractured world and leave behind a song that would be remembered for generations.

Physical Description: 6'5 wall of muscle with gorgeous long blonde hair. He often wears furs and leathers of slain beasts, the most striking being one of a large bear-like beast. His skin is littered with tattoos

Standing at 5'6", Yoyoy's body is emaciated and his skin has an almost rotten pallor as his own poisonous Qi runs amok due to deviation. Less than a dozen hairs cling desperately to his scalp, and his facial features are sunken in. His eyes are clouded with a red haze that glows dimly.

His belongings are limited to a well-worn robe and a thick rope belt, as well as a wooden staff which doubles as a walking stick.
Story Summary: An old cultivator from Sangang-Daan who suffered qi deviation when he and his disciples were captured by Defilers. His disciples sacrificed themselves to allow him to escape, wandering the deserts as a husk of his former self. On the brink of death by starvation and self-inflicted poison, Yoyoy was claimed by the Worldhelm.

Physical Description:
Yui has done everything she can to get away from being perceived as cute. Primarily this consists of body mods to make her teeth sharp with tusks that jut from the lower jaw, horns on her head, and red skin to make her look more a monster than a human. However she also carries herself with a tough no nonsense sort of attitude, standing at an impressive 6'1" and giving off a cool defiance to anyone who deals with her. She keeps her hair chopped short and dyed in an androgynous way.

Even through all the toughness she still likes to appear somewhat feminine, she prefers dresses, and can often be seen wearing feminine accessories. Though she draws attention away from them with tougher looking clothing like, belts, chains, and leather. Despite the façade, she can't always hide her gentler side, she sometimes lights up when she sees something she finds cute, though these moments are brief.
Rare Equipment: Mirror Snowflake
Story Summary:
- Yui never saw her dad and was raised by her mom, sometime in middle school her mom was arrested by a corporate security company for crimes she didn't commit.
- From there Yui grew up on the mean streets struggling to survive and harboring a hatred anybody who would pray on the weak.
- She started standing up for people against corpos and criminals, becoming known as a street tough private investigator.
- Not wanting to appear weak (or cute) she took on body mods to make herself appear more like a monster.
- Through her adventures she learned she had some kind of connection to the world itself, particularly the electricity that buzzed around the city. But this also seemed to include animals and other things as well.
- Eventually she was summoned to the Worldhelm where she's been spending most of her recent time.

Physical Description: A white and grey fox, adorned with charms, and an ever present smirk.
Story Summary:
- Raised by Kuzonoha priests to guard their village shrine

- Snuck out into the woods often, one day met a wounded Ald lad named Jesper. Instead of killing him, she healed him and sent him on his way.

-The two met again many times, and grew close. One day, Yukari took Jesper to her village in secret.

-The next day, there were raiders at the gate, a regretful Jesper among them.

-The raiders were repelled at great cost. Jesper fled. And Yukari was banished for her treason, left to wander the snow alone.

-Two years later, after witnessing Ragnarok and choosing not to run, she became a Goldhearted.

Physical Description:
Standing at 7'3" to the top of her head, and upwards of 9' with her 'horns', Yuki-Na cuts an imposing figure.
Somewhat fox-like in appearance, by day her soft white fur flows across her pelt like snowdrifts and down to a long but flat, fluffy tail, while at night, the fur shifts to an onyx black.
From her head sprouts horn-like tree branches, their appearance shifting with her mood and goals: at times, the branches spring with eternally falling cherry blossoms, while at others, they alight with a ghostly blue fire.

Yuri Sokolov is tall, sports a lithe frame with short brown hair and brown eyes. He has a state of the art combat attire, and an experimental bow. His demeanor is distant, he clearly has trouble making friends.

A broad and heavy body individual, a physique showing some time both honing oneself along with his fair share of fights. Standing well over 6 foot, despite his wolf like appearance he looks put together and profesional. Dressed usually in a white overcoat that resembles a modernized Hakama. His weapon of choice an augmented blade with multiple hilts that resemble Tengu masks. His two most striking features are his sharp eye, the other covered with an eyepatch.
